items.title: 〈焦點股〉SK海力士擬砸10兆韓元赴日設廠 2檔日本半導體ETF應聲強漲
items.title_en: Focus Stock: SK Hynix Plans to Spend 10 trillion won on a Japanese plant, two Japan semiconductor ETFs jump
paras: 南韓記憶體大廠SK海力士正評估於日本宮城縣興建記憶體製造廠，投資規模上看10兆韓元。根據過往經驗，外資企業赴日設廠時，通常需導入部分日本本土供應鏈，若該投資案最終拍板，將顯著帶動日本半導體設備與材料供應商受惠，為產業注入強勁利多。受此消息與產業前景激勵，在台掛牌的日本股票 ETF 今(24)日盤中普遍走揚。
相較於以大盤為主的日經225相關ETF表現較疲弱，聚焦半導體產業的ETF表現格外突出，其中，中信日本半導體(00954-TW) 及 台新日本半導體(00951-TW) 漲勢領先，盤中漲幅高居所有日本ETF前兩名。
統計至8月21日，中信日本半導體ETF囊括日本最具競爭力的半導體設備、測試及材料龍頭企業，其中愛德萬測試(Advantest)、東京威力科創(Tokyo Electron)及迪思(Disco)等個股持股比重皆超過10%。
今日亞股整體走勢呈現震盪整理，主因美國PCE數據及輝達(NVIDIA)財報即將公布，市場觀望氣氛濃厚。日經指數則於66,000點附近高檔盤整，但半導體族群表現相對亮眼。法人表示，日本半導體類股上週雖經歷一波修正，但並非產業基本面出現變化，隨著評價面回落至合理區間，買盤自然回流，顯見逢低承接力道持續增溫。
中信日本半導體ETF經理人許家瑜表示，在雲端服務供應商(CSP)持續擴大AI資本支出的帶動下，晶圓廠與記憶體廠的擴產及技術升級步調加快。目前AI產業仍處於「淘金熱」階段，各業者積極投入資源搶占市場，相較之下，更看好位於半導體產業鏈中上游、扮演「賣鏟者」角色的設備與材料供應商。
許家瑜進一步指出，晶圓廠與記憶體廠擴產需持續採購設備，而設備廠在完成驗收後即可認列營收。在CSP加碼投資AI基礎建設的環境下，日本半導體產業透過每月公布的銷售數據，展現出高度成長動能。除了當前獲利能見度高之外，未來即使AI應用逐步成熟，相關基礎建設需求仍將持續存在，不致輕易消退。

paras_en: South Korea's memory chip giant SK Hynix is evaluating the construction of a memory manufacturing plant in Miyagi Prefecture, Japan, with an investment size of about 10 trillion won. Based on past experience, foreign companies setting up factories in Japan usually need to incorporate parts of the domestic supply chain; if the project is approved, it will significantly benefit Japanese semiconductor equipment and material suppliers, injecting strong upside into the industry. The news and the positive outlook have lifted Japanese stock ETFs listed in Taiwan, which rose broadly during intraday trading on the 24th.

Compared with broader market‑focused Nikkei 225‑related ETFs, which performed relatively weakly, semiconductor‑focused ETFs stood out, with CTBC Japan Semiconductor (00954‑TW) and Taishin Japan Semiconductor (00951‑TW) leading the gains and ranking as the top two gainers among all Japan ETFs during the session.

As of August 21, the CTBC Japan Semiconductor ETF holds the most competitive Japanese semiconductor equipment, testing and material leaders, with holdings such as Advantest, Tokyo Electron and Disco each exceeding a 10% weight in the portfolio.

Today's Asian equity market showed a volatile, consolidating pattern, mainly because U.S. PCE data and NVIDIA’s earnings report are pending, creating a cautious atmosphere. The Nikkei index hovered around the 66,000‑point high‑end range, while the semiconductor sector performed relatively well. Institutional investors said that although Japan’s semiconductor stocks underwent a correction last week, it did not reflect a change in industry fundamentals; as valuations fell back to reasonable levels, buying pressure naturally returned, indicating that buying on dips remains strong.

CTBC Japan Semiconductor ETF manager Hsu Chia‑Yu said that as cloud service providers (CSPs) continue to expand AI capital expenditures, wafer fabs and memory makers are accelerating capacity expansions and technology upgrades. The AI industry is still in a "gold‑rush" phase, with companies aggressively investing to capture market share, and Hsu is more optimistic about upstream equipment and material suppliers that act as the "shovel sellers" in the semiconductor value chain.

Hsu added that wafer fabs and memory makers need to keep purchasing equipment for capacity expansions, and equipment makers can recognize revenue as soon as the equipment passes acceptance tests. In an environment where CSPs are increasing AI infrastructure investments, Japan’s semiconductor industry shows strong growth momentum through its monthly sales data releases. Besides the current high earnings visibility, even as AI applications mature, the demand for related infrastructure will persist and is unlikely to fade quickly.

items.title: 恒生科技指數成分股擬擴至50檔 預計帶來那些影響？
items.title_en: HSBC Technology Index to Expand to 50 Constituents, Expected Impacts
paras: 恒生指數公司於8月針對恒生科技指數的編算方法提出修訂諮詢意見，規劃將成分股數量由現行的30檔擴大至50檔。此舉旨在因應香港科技類股結構的持續擴張，並解決過去僅以市值為單一選股框架時，高成長但市值偏小的企業無法被納入的現狀。
中金公司認為，短期而言，新機制的調整預期將為潛在納入的個股帶來資金流入等正面影響。就長期視角來看，前十大權重占比的降低將使指數結構更為均衡，有助於增強恒生科技指數對港股科技板塊的整體代表性與吸引力。
根據編算修訂建議，本次調整的核心包含三大方向：首先是成分股數量的大幅擴充；其次是全面取消傳統產業分類限制，將候選公司重新歸類於「人工智慧」、「先進硬體」、「機器人與自動化」、「雲端」、「前沿科技」及「數位平台及解決方案」等重構後的六大科技主題；最後則是引入「市值＋營收成長」的雙組別選股機制，協助高成長性的技術企業能有管道納入指數中。
針對此次擴容計畫，市場機構與分析師提出了多角度看法。匯豐晉信基金指出，恒生科技指數近年表現承壓，核心原因在於「硬科技」與人工智慧領域的曝險不足，未能充分享受此波AI行情的紅利。若依照模擬測算，擴容後前十大權重股的占比將從70.6%降至66.3%，有助於邊際上降低權重集中度、提升指數的廣度與科技產業鏈的完整性。
不過，也有分析師認為，在現行個股權重計算方式不變的前提下，新增設的「營收成長組別」（預估10檔）在指數中的初始總權重僅約2.4%，遠低於既有成分股，因此能吸引到的被動型基金資金流入規模相對有限。
過去，港股財報揭露週期多為半年，這導致在確認營收高速成長並納入指數時可能存在時間上的滯後，且無法完全排除循環性產業在景氣高點被納入後增速隨即下滑的風險。
根據官方時程表，此項編算修訂方案預計於2026年9月底公布最終決定，並計畫在2026年12月的指數調整中正式生效。
paras_en: HSBC Index Company issued a revision consultation on August to modify the calculation method of the HSBC Technology Index, planning to increase the number of constituents from the current 30 to 50. This move aims to respond to the continued expansion of Hong Kong’s technology sector and to address the past limitation where high‑growth, small‑market‑cap companies could not be included under a sole market‑cap selection framework.

China International Capital Corp. believes that in the short term, the new mechanism will bring positive effects such as capital inflows to potential constituents. In the long term, reducing the weight of the top ten constituents will make the index structure more balanced, enhancing the overall representativeness and attractiveness of the HSBC Technology Index for Hong Kong’s tech sector.

The core of the proposed revision includes three main directions: first, a substantial expansion of constituent numbers; second, a complete removal of traditional industry classification limits, reclassifying candidate companies into six restructured tech themes—Artificial Intelligence, Advanced Hardware, Robotics & Automation, Cloud, Frontier Technology, and Digital Platforms & Solutions; third, the introduction of a dual‑group selection mechanism based on "market‑cap + revenue growth" to help high‑growth tech firms gain entry into the index.

Market institutions and analysts offered multiple perspectives on the expansion plan. HSBC JINXIN Fund noted that the HSBC Technology Index has been underperforming in recent years, mainly due to insufficient exposure to "hard tech" and AI, failing to fully benefit from the AI wave. Simulated calculations suggest that after expansion, the top ten weightings would drop from 70.6% to 66.3%, marginally reducing concentration, broadening the index, and improving the completeness of the tech industry chain.

However, some analysts argue that, with the current individual weight calculation unchanged, the newly added "revenue growth group" (estimated 10 constituents) would initially hold only about 2.4% of the total weight, far below existing constituents, so the passive fund capital inflow attracted would be relatively limited.

In the past, Hong Kong stock reports were released semiannually, which could delay confirmation of rapid revenue growth and inclusion in the index, and cannot fully eliminate the risk that cyclical industries may see growth rates decline immediately after being added during an economic boom.

According to the official schedule, the revised calculation plan is expected to announce a final decision by the end of September 2026, with the changes to take effect in the December 2026 index adjustment.

items.title: 中國人形機器人第一股 市值較首日開盤蒸發2,000億
items.title_en: China's First Humanoid Robot Stock Sees Market Value Lose 200 Billion Yuan Since Debut
paras: 中國股市24日（周一）開盤後，中國人形機器人第一股宇樹科技(688836-CN) 股價走低，盤中跌超過10%，相較首日開盤市值人民幣4,449億元，宇樹科技市值已跌掉2,000億元。
宇樹科技20日發布仿生7軸靈巧機械臂，採用高精度七軸仿生關節，售價人民幣9,900元起，自重5.5kg。
宇樹科技表示，通過雙機械臂協同配合，實現物料分揀裝配；適配各類科研教育場景，可也探索服務機器人應用。
paras_en: After the Chinese stock market opened on Monday the 24th, the shares of Yushu Technology (688836-CN), the first listed Chinese humanoid robot company, fell, dropping more than 10% intraday. Compared with its opening market value of RMB 444.9 billion on the first day, Yushu Technology's market cap has already lost RMB 200 billion.
On the 20th, Yushu Technology announced a bionic 7‑axis dexterous robotic arm that uses high‑precision seven‑axis bionic joints, priced from RMB 9,900, and weighing 5.5 kg.

Yushu Technology said that by coordinating two robotic arms, it can achieve material sorting and assembly; the system is suitable for various scientific research and education scenarios and can also explore service‑robot applications.

items.title: 〈焦點股〉視陽矽水膠產品需求旺續擴充產能 走揚站穩所有均線
items.title_en: Focus Stock: Vision Sun Expands Capacity as Demand for Silicon Water Gel Products Remains Strong, Stock Rises and Holds All Moving Averages
paras: 隱形眼鏡廠視陽(6782-TW)受惠矽水膠產品需求暢旺，中國與日本市場展望正向，為因應強勁需求，視陽持續擴充產能，預計至今年第四季月產能將提升至6300萬片，法人看好視陽獲利將逐年成長，激勵視陽今(24)日走揚，站穩所有均線。
視陽中國與日本客戶需求強勁，高單價彩片系列銷售暢旺，訂單能見度約3個月，且與部分客戶的產品規劃延伸至2027年。由於需求暢旺，目前整體稼動率達95%，其中，彩片產能近乎滿載，視陽主要擴充彩片產能，預計至第四季月產能將從5500萬片至6300萬片。
法人指出，待視陽產能陸續釋出後，除可供應中國與日本市場，也可望進一步帶動歐洲市場營收回溫。整體而言，預期第三季與第四季營收與獲利都將年增雙位數百分比。
視陽今天早盤以205元開高，盤中最高漲至212元，漲幅超過4%，截至午盤，股價暫報210元，漲幅約3.96%，成交量約300張。
paras_en: Vision Sun (6782-TW), an eye‑contact lens manufacturer, benefits from robust demand for its silicon water gel products, with positive outlooks in China and Japan. To meet strong demand, Vision Sun is continually expanding capacity, expecting its monthly output to reach 63 million lenses by the fourth quarter of this year. Analysts are optimistic that Vision Sun’s profits will grow year over year, which helped the stock rise today and maintain all moving averages.

Demand from Vision Sun’s Chinese and Japanese customers remains strong, with high‑priced colored lens series selling well. Order visibility is about three months, and product plans with some customers extend to 2027. With demand high, overall utilization is at 95%, and colored lens capacity is nearly full. Vision Sun is mainly expanding colored lens capacity, expecting monthly output to rise from 55 million to 63 million lenses by the fourth quarter.

Analysts note that once Vision Sun’s capacity is gradually released, it will not only supply China and Japan but also potentially boost revenue recovery in Europe. Overall, revenue and profit for the third and fourth quarters are expected to grow double‑digit percentages year over year.
Vision Sun opened the morning session at 205 NT, peaked at 212 NT, a rise of over 4%. By midday the share price was about 210 NT, up roughly 3.96%, with trading volume around 300 lots.

items.title: 〈焦點股〉貿聯財報利多出盡+資安事件影響 重挫跌停摜破月、季線
items.title_en: Focus Stock: TradeLink's Earnings Boom Exhausted, Cybersecurity Incident Drives Stock to 2050, Breaking Monthly, Quarterly, and Semi-Annual Lines
paras: 連接線大廠貿聯-KY(3665-TW)第二季獲利創高，上半年也來到同期最佳，但今(24)日股價利多出盡，加上發生網路安全事件影響，盤中出量重挫跌停來到2050元，摜破月、季及半年線。
貿聯今日上午公告，部分資訊系統遭受網路安全事件，公司於偵測到異常後，已立即啟動資安應變機制與隔離受影響之資訊系統措施，進行全面清查與復原作業，並同步委請外部資安專家協助復原與調查。
貿聯表示，經初步評估對公司整體營運及財務無重大影響，將持續提升網路與資訊基礎架構之資安防護姿態（security posture），以確保資料安全與營運韌性。
貿聯第二季營收232.81億元，季增11.59%、年增37.49%、毛利率30.73%，季增1.96個百分點、年減0.39個百分點、稅後純益29.82億元，季增31.13%、年增47.29%，每股純益15.28元。
貿聯上半年營收441.45億元，年增33.55%、毛利率29.80%，年減0.95個百分點；稅後純益52.56億元，年增44.52%，每股純益26.94元，均創歷史新高。
paras_en: TradeLink (KY 3665-TW), a major cable manufacturer, achieved record profits in Q2 and also hit a peak in the first half of the year, but on the 24th the stock’s upside was exhausted and a cybersecurity incident further triggered a sharp volume drop, sending the share price to a 20‑50‑point limit down at 2,050, breaking its monthly, quarterly, and half‑year lines.

TradeLink announced this morning that some of its information systems had been affected by a cybersecurity incident. Upon detecting anomalies, the company immediately activated its security response mechanisms and isolated the impacted systems, conducting a comprehensive audit and recovery, while also engaging external security experts to assist with restoration and investigation.

TradeLink stated that preliminary assessments indicate no significant impact on overall operations or finances, and it will continue to strengthen its cybersecurity posture for its network and information infrastructure to ensure data security and operational resilience.

TradeLink’s Q2 revenue was 23.281 billion NTD, up 11.59% quarter‑on‑quarter and 37.49% year‑on‑year, with a gross margin of 30.73%, up 1.96 percentage points quarter‑on‑quarter and down 0.39 percentage points year‑on‑year. Net profit after tax was 2.982 billion NTD, up 31.13% quarter‑on‑quarter and 47.29% year‑on‑year, translating to earnings per share of 15.28 NTD.

TradeLink’s first‑half revenue reached 44.145 billion NTD, up 33.55% year‑on‑year, with a gross margin of 29.80%, down 0.95 percentage points year‑on‑year. Net profit after tax was 5.256 billion NTD, up 44.52% year‑on‑year, yielding earnings per share of 26.94 NTD, all setting new historical highs.

items.title: 美債危機進入倒數？達里歐警告恐在3年內爆發
items.title_en: Ray Dalio Warns U.S. Debt Crisis May Explode Within Three Years
paras: 橋水基金創辦人達里歐（Ray Dalio）再度示警，美國債務問題正朝危機逼近，若現況未改變，債務危機可能在未來三年內爆發、上下浮動約兩年。他建議投資人降低債券等債務類資產配置，提高黃金比重，並持有少量比特幣。
全球長期公債近期遭遇拋售，美國長債殖利率持續攀升，達利歐日前在專欄文章指出，近期日本拋售美債支撐日元、美國長期公債殖利率走高，以及美國財長貝森特近期的相關表態，都與他在《國家為什麼會破產：橋水基金應對大週期的原則》中描述的經典模式相符。
他認為，持續攀升的債務償付成本，最終將與投資人需求不足發生衝突，迫使政府接受更高利率，或由央行透過印鈔購買國債，後者將進一步削弱貨幣價值並推升通膨。
以美國為例，達里歐估算，美國政府今年總收入約5.5兆美元，總支出約7.5兆美元，預算缺口約2兆美元；目前債務餘額則約32兆美元，不計政府間債務，相當於政府年收入的近6倍，每年利息支出更超過1兆美元。
若把美國政府視為一家企業，光是支付利息就占年收入約20%，同時還有約10兆美元債券本金需要償還。
換言之，美國政府需要從市場籌措約11兆美元，才能避免主權債務違約，融資規模相當於年收入的兩倍。
達里歐因此預測，若美國未設法扭轉目前局面，債務危機「可能在三年內爆發，上下浮動兩年左右」。而且面臨債務壓力的不只美國，他認為，在各經濟體經歷債務與貨幣貶值調整期間，黃金與比特幣等資產的相對表現可能較佳。
在資產配置方面，達里歐主張充分分散投資，選擇收入狀況與資產負債表穩健，且國內政治及外部地緣衝突較低的國家與資產類別。他建議低配債券等債務類資產、超配黃金，同時配置少量比特幣。
其中，他認為個人資金可有一小部分、例如10%至15%配置黃金，不僅有助降低整體投資組合風險，也可能提高整體報酬率。
巧合的是，黃金與比特幣上周五(21日)同步走強，現貨黃金一度漲逾2%，睽違3個月重返每盎司4,600美元上方；比特幣則一度逼近8萬美元。
事實上，達里歐對美國債務問題的警告已持續多年，近年更頻繁強調美國正處於大債務週期末期。針對如何延後甚至化解危機，他認為美國必須「三管齊下」，透過削減支出、增加稅收及降低利率，將目前約占GDP 6%的預算赤字壓低至3%。
paras_en: Ray Dalio, founder of Bridgewater Associates, again warns that the U.S. debt problem is approaching a crisis. If the current situation does not change, a debt crisis could erupt within the next three years, fluctuating for about two years. He advises investors to reduce allocations to bonds and other debt assets, increase gold holdings, and hold a small amount of Bitcoin.

Global long‑term government bonds have recently been sold off, and U.S. long‑term bond yields have continued to rise. In a recent column, Dalio noted that Japan’s recent sale of U.S. Treasuries, the rise in U.S. long‑term yields, and Treasury Secretary Janet Yellen’s recent statements all match the classic pattern he describes in "Why Nations Fail: Principles for Responding to the Great Cycle."

He believes that the continuously rising debt‑service costs will eventually clash with insufficient investor demand, forcing the government to accept higher rates or for the central bank to print money to buy bonds. The latter would further erode monetary value and drive inflation.

Taking the United States as an example, Dalio estimates that the U.S. government’s total revenue this year is about $5.5 trillion, total spending about $7.5 trillion, and a budget deficit of roughly $2 trillion. The current debt balance is about $32 trillion, excluding intergovernmental debt, which is nearly six times the government’s annual revenue, and annual interest payments exceed $1 trillion.
If the U.S. government is viewed as a corporation, paying interest alone consumes about 20% of annual revenue, and there is also about $10 trillion in bond principal that must be repaid.
In other words, the U.S. government would need to raise about $11 trillion from the market to avoid a sovereign debt default, a financing scale equivalent to twice its annual revenue.

Dalio therefore predicts that if the U.S. fails to reverse the current situation, the debt crisis "could erupt within three years, fluctuating for about two years." He also notes that the debt pressure is not limited to the U.S.; during periods of debt and currency devaluation adjustments in various economies, assets such as gold and Bitcoin may perform relatively better.

In terms of asset allocation, Dalio advocates full diversification, choosing countries and asset classes with stable income, robust balance sheets, and low domestic political and external geopolitical conflict. He recommends a low allocation to bonds and other debt assets, an overweight allocation to gold, and a small allocation to Bitcoin.
Specifically, he believes that individuals can allocate a small portion, such as 10% to 15%, to gold, which not only helps reduce overall portfolio risk but may also increase overall returns.

Coincidentally, gold and Bitcoin both strengthened on Friday, the 21st, with spot gold rising more than 2% at one point, returning above $4,600 per ounce for the first time in three months, while Bitcoin approached $80,000 at one point.

In fact, Dalio’s warning about U.S. debt has persisted for years, and in recent years he has increasingly emphasized that the U.S. is in the late stage of a major debt cycle. To delay or even resolve the crisis, he believes the U.S. must "take three measures together": cut spending, raise taxes, and lower interest rates to reduce the current budget deficit, which is about 6% of GDP, to 3%.

items.title: 避險基金加碼做空美元   貝森特擴大長債回購引發信心危機
items.title_en: Hedge Funds Ramp Up Short Positions on the Dollar as Bentsen Expands Long‑Term Treasury Repurchase, Triggering Confidence Crisis
paras: 市場靜待美國財長貝森特公佈新財政計畫細節應對借貸成本居數十年高點之際，避險基金正大舉加碼美元空頭押注。
上周三(19日)，貝森特宣佈將10至30年期美債回購規模「至少翻倍」，美元應聲創下近三週最大單日跌幅紀錄，現貨市場湧現拋售潮，今(24)日在亞洲匯市早盤則變化不大。
巴克莱銀行G10貨幣交易聯席主管Torsten Schöneborn指出，避險基金在線性外匯交易上反應尤為劇烈，延續8月以來的美元賣壓。
投資人擔憂，美國財政部以激進手段壓長端利率，等於用行政力量扭曲定價，最終將侵蝕市場對美元的信心。
與此同時，選擇權市場也釋出悲觀信號：防範美元未來一個月下跌的溢價已攀升至2月以來最高。
花旗亞太區外匯選擇權主管 Akshay Saxena表示，自長債回購計畫公佈後，對沖美元下行風險的需求明顯擴散，貝森特的「殖利率管理」正把財政部推向聯準會(Fed)的角色，而代價可能是美元儲備貨幣的光環進一步褪色。
paras_en: The market is awaiting Treasury Secretary Janet Bentsen’s announcement of new fiscal plans to address borrowing costs at multi‑decade highs, while hedge funds are dramatically increasing short bets on the dollar.

On Wednesday (19th), Bentsen announced that the Treasury’s 10‑ to 30‑year Treasury repurchase program would be "at least doubled," prompting the dollar to record its largest single‑day decline in nearly three weeks; the spot market saw a wave of sell‑offs, and the Asian currency market remained largely unchanged on Thursday (24th).

Torsten Schöneborn, co‑head of G10 currency trading at Barclays, noted that hedge funds are reacting especially sharply in linear FX trading, continuing the dollar selling pressure that has persisted since August.
Investors worry that the Treasury’s aggressive tactics to suppress long‑term rates amount to using executive power to distort pricing, ultimately eroding confidence in the dollar.
At the same time, the options market is sending a bearish signal: the premium to hedge against a dollar decline over the next month has risen to its highest level since February.

Akshay Saxena, head of FX options for Citi Asia Pacific, said that since the long‑term repurchase plan was announced, demand to hedge against dollar downside has clearly expanded; Bentsen’s "yield‑management" is pushing the Treasury toward a Fed‑like role, and the cost may be further erosion of the dollar’s reserve‑currency halo.

items.title: 明年基本工資3萬 工總：支持幫員工加薪、提建言籲政府不應獨厚半導體忽略傳產
items.title_en: Next Year Minimum Wage Set at NT$30,000; Federation of Labor Supports Pay Raises, Urges Government Not to Favor Semiconductors Over Traditional Industries
paras: 工業總會今(24)日上午舉行「2026年工總白皮書」發表記者會。對下(9)即將審議明(2027)年最低月薪工資，因卓揆對外釋出月薪一定超過3萬元。工總理事長潘俊榮今(24)日表示，只要產業有獲利，產業界一定支持政府對的政策，另對目前台灣產業過度傾向科技、半導體產業靠攏，他也提出台灣傳統產業目前的困境，呼籲台灣不能僅有AI，政府應將資源分配在傳產，促進台灣產業資金均衡發展。
工總今日舉行「2026年工總白皮書」發表記者會，現場匯聚工總監事召集人聯華(1229-TW)副董苗豐盛及4位副理事長暨產業大老皆到場主持與會。
針對調漲月薪將超過3萬元，潘俊榮在受訪時表示，只要企業有賺錢，為什麼要怕幫員工加薪?他認為受到AI及半導體產業表現優秀下，是政府稅收盈餘增加最堆，是政府「近39年以來最有錢的時候」，在企業有賺錢下，理應幫員工調漲薪資，他個人是相當支持，台灣在目前執政團隊領導下，也是目前是全東南亞發展最好的國家之一。
潘俊榮強調，政府資金有盈餘應該要全民共享，包括總統賴清德季芹也宣布明年要普發現金1萬元，就是與全民共享經濟成果。同時，企業若能讓經營成果由企業、員工及社會共同分享，從過去經驗來看，將能形成「三贏」局面，他認為企業若有賺錢，就應要與員工分享獲利。
但潘俊榮也提及示警，台灣絕不能只有AI，傳統產業仍是台灣產業的磐石，目前傳統產業面臨許多困境，包括缺工、缺人、薪資較低，政府應該要加強扶持傳產的力道，潘俊榮說，特別是現在國內建築業很冷，政府應將資源轉向並關注在傳產上。
對於國內能源政策部分，潘俊榮則建議政府採納多元能源政策，讓企業對於供電憂慮就不會那麼大，加上能源管理法若能修法讓用電大戶自設電廠，也讓能源政策穩定，尤其是核二、核三廠應準備重啟，讓台灣能源更穩定且能夠多元化發展，潘俊榮認為「產業不怕挑戰，就怕不穩定」，工總希望政府能重新檢視國家能源政策的適宜性。
工總每年都針對政府政策提出白皮書建言，今年工總白皮書，針對缺工、產業轉型、能源政策產業最關切的三大議題向政府提出建言，工總每年均獲政府高度重視，去年提出的建言高達75%被政府採納執行，成為行政部門與工總重要的對話平台。
paras_en: The Federation of Labor held a press conference this morning (the 24th) to release the "2026 Federation White Paper." Regarding the upcoming review of the minimum monthly wage for 2027, Chairman Pan Jun‑rong said that as long as industries are profitable, the business community will fully support the government’s policies. He also warned that Taiwan’s economy is overly tilted toward technology and semiconductors, and highlighted the current difficulties faced by traditional sectors, urging that Taiwan should not rely solely on AI and that the government should allocate resources to traditional industries to promote balanced capital development across sectors.

The Federation’s press conference for the "2026 Federation White Paper" was attended by Federation convenor Lianhua (ticker 1229‑TW) Vice Chairman Miao Feng‑sheng and four vice‑chairmen, all prominent industry veterans, who chaired the event.

Commenting on the proposed wage increase to over NT$30,000, Pan Jun‑rong said that if companies are making profits, there is no reason to fear giving employees higher pay. He noted that strong performance in AI and the semiconductor sector has boosted tax revenues, making this the richest period for the government in the past 39 years, and therefore companies should raise salaries. He expressed personal support and said Taiwan, under the current administration, is now one of the best‑developing economies in Southeast Asia.

Pan emphasized that surplus government funds should be shared with all citizens, citing President Lai Ching‑te’s announcement to distribute a NT$10,000 cash payment to everyone next year as an example of sharing economic gains. He added that when companies share their earnings with employees and society, a "win‑win‑win" outcome can be achieved, and that profitable firms have an obligation to share profits with their workers.

However, Pan warned that Taiwan cannot rely solely on AI; traditional industries remain the backbone of the economy. These sectors face challenges such as labor shortages, low wages, and a lack of talent. He called for stronger government support for traditional manufacturing, especially noting the current slump in the domestic construction industry and urging a shift of resources toward these sectors.

On energy policy, Pan suggested the government adopt a diversified energy mix so that companies are less concerned about power supply. He advocated amending the Energy Management Act to allow large electricity users to build their own power plants and urged the preparation for restarting the second and third nuclear plants, arguing that stable, diversified energy is essential because "industries fear instability, not challenges." The Federation hopes the government will re‑examine the suitability of national energy policies.

Each year the Federation issues a white‑paper with policy recommendations. This year’s paper focuses on three key concerns: labor shortages, industrial transformation, and energy policy. The Federation’s suggestions are highly regarded by the government; last year, 75% of its recommendations were adopted, making it an important dialogue platform between the administration and the labor organization.

items.title: 〈焦點股〉SK海力士擬砸10兆韓元赴日設廠 2檔日本半導體ETF應聲強漲
items.title_en: Focus Stock: SK Hynix Plans to Spend 10 trillion won on a Japanese plant, two Japan semiconductor ETFs jump
paras: 南韓記憶體大廠SK海力士正評估於日本宮城縣興建記憶體製造廠，投資規模上看10兆韓元。根據過往經驗，外資企業赴日設廠時，通常需導入部分日本本土供應鏈，若該投資案最終拍板，將顯著帶動日本半導體設備與材料供應商受惠，為產業注入強勁利多。受此消息與產業前景激勵，在台掛牌的日本股票 ETF 今(24)日盤中普遍走揚。
相較於以大盤為主的日經225相關ETF表現較疲弱，聚焦半導體產業的ETF表現格外突出，其中，中信日本半導體(00954-TW) 及 台新日本半導體(00951-TW) 漲勢領先，盤中漲幅高居所有日本ETF前兩名。
統計至8月21日，中信日本半導體ETF囊括日本最具競爭力的半導體設備、測試及材料龍頭企業，其中愛德萬測試(Advantest)、東京威力科創(Tokyo Electron)及迪思(Disco)等個股持股比重皆超過10%。
今日亞股整體走勢呈現震盪整理，主因美國PCE數據及輝達(NVIDIA)財報即將公布，市場觀望氣氛濃厚。日經指數則於66,000點附近高檔盤整，但半導體族群表現相對亮眼。法人表示，日本半導體類股上週雖經歷一波修正，但並非產業基本面出現變化，隨著評價面回落至合理區間，買盤自然回流，顯見逢低承接力道持續增溫。
中信日本半導體ETF經理人許家瑜表示，在雲端服務供應商(CSP)持續擴大AI資本支出的帶動下，晶圓廠與記憶體廠的擴產及技術升級步調加快。目前AI產業仍處於「淘金熱」階段，各業者積極投入資源搶占市場，相較之下，更看好位於半導體產業鏈中上游、扮演「賣鏟者」角色的設備與材料供應商。
許家瑜進一步指出，晶圓廠與記憶體廠擴產需持續採購設備，而設備廠在完成驗收後即可認列營收。在CSP加碼投資AI基礎建設的環境下，日本半導體產業透過每月公布的銷售數據，展現出高度成長動能。除了當前獲利能見度高之外，未來即使AI應用逐步成熟，相關基礎建設需求仍將持續存在，不致輕易消退。

paras_en: South Korea's memory chip giant SK Hynix is evaluating the construction of a memory manufacturing plant in Miyagi Prefecture, Japan, with an investment size of about 10 trillion won. Based on past experience, foreign companies setting up factories in Japan usually need to incorporate parts of the domestic supply chain; if the project is approved, it will significantly benefit Japanese semiconductor equipment and material suppliers, injecting strong upside into the industry. The news and the positive outlook have lifted Japanese stock ETFs listed in Taiwan, which rose broadly during intraday trading on the 24th.

Compared with broader market‑focused Nikkei 225‑related ETFs, which performed relatively weakly, semiconductor‑focused ETFs stood out, with CTBC Japan Semiconductor (00954‑TW) and Taishin Japan Semiconductor (00951‑TW) leading the gains and ranking as the top two gainers among all Japan ETFs during the session.

As of August 21, the CTBC Japan Semiconductor ETF holds the most competitive Japanese semiconductor equipment, testing and material leaders, with holdings such as Advantest, Tokyo Electron and Disco each exceeding a 10% weight in the portfolio.

Today's Asian equity market showed a volatile, consolidating pattern, mainly because U.S. PCE data and NVIDIA’s earnings report are pending, creating a cautious atmosphere. The Nikkei index hovered around the 66,000‑point high‑end range, while the semiconductor sector performed relatively well. Institutional investors said that although Japan’s semiconductor stocks underwent a correction last week, it did not reflect a change in industry fundamentals; as valuations fell back to reasonable levels, buying pressure naturally returned, indicating that buying on dips remains strong.

CTBC Japan Semiconductor ETF manager Hsu Chia‑Yu said that as cloud service providers (CSPs) continue to expand AI capital expenditures, wafer fabs and memory makers are accelerating capacity expansions and technology upgrades. The AI industry is still in a "gold‑rush" phase, with companies aggressively investing to capture market share, and Hsu is more optimistic about upstream equipment and material suppliers that act as the "shovel sellers" in the semiconductor value chain.

Hsu added that wafer fabs and memory makers need to keep purchasing equipment for capacity expansions, and equipment makers can recognize revenue as soon as the equipment passes acceptance tests. In an environment where CSPs are increasing AI infrastructure investments, Japan’s semiconductor industry shows strong growth momentum through its monthly sales data releases. Besides the current high earnings visibility, even as AI applications mature, the demand for related infrastructure will persist and is unlikely to fade quickly.

items.title: 〈焦點股〉視陽矽水膠產品需求旺續擴充產能 走揚站穩所有均線
items.title_en: Focus Stock: Vision Sun Expands Capacity as Demand for Silicon Water Gel Products Remains Strong, Stock Rises and Holds All Moving Averages
paras: 隱形眼鏡廠視陽(6782-TW)受惠矽水膠產品需求暢旺，中國與日本市場展望正向，為因應強勁需求，視陽持續擴充產能，預計至今年第四季月產能將提升至6300萬片，法人看好視陽獲利將逐年成長，激勵視陽今(24)日走揚，站穩所有均線。
視陽中國與日本客戶需求強勁，高單價彩片系列銷售暢旺，訂單能見度約3個月，且與部分客戶的產品規劃延伸至2027年。由於需求暢旺，目前整體稼動率達95%，其中，彩片產能近乎滿載，視陽主要擴充彩片產能，預計至第四季月產能將從5500萬片至6300萬片。
法人指出，待視陽產能陸續釋出後，除可供應中國與日本市場，也可望進一步帶動歐洲市場營收回溫。整體而言，預期第三季與第四季營收與獲利都將年增雙位數百分比。
視陽今天早盤以205元開高，盤中最高漲至212元，漲幅超過4%，截至午盤，股價暫報210元，漲幅約3.96%，成交量約300張。
paras_en: Vision Sun (6782-TW), an eye‑contact lens manufacturer, benefits from robust demand for its silicon water gel products, with positive outlooks in China and Japan. To meet strong demand, Vision Sun is continually expanding capacity, expecting its monthly output to reach 63 million lenses by the fourth quarter of this year. Analysts are optimistic that Vision Sun’s profits will grow year over year, which helped the stock rise today and maintain all moving averages.

Demand from Vision Sun’s Chinese and Japanese customers remains strong, with high‑priced colored lens series selling well. Order visibility is about three months, and product plans with some customers extend to 2027. With demand high, overall utilization is at 95%, and colored lens capacity is nearly full. Vision Sun is mainly expanding colored lens capacity, expecting monthly output to rise from 55 million to 63 million lenses by the fourth quarter.

Analysts note that once Vision Sun’s capacity is gradually released, it will not only supply China and Japan but also potentially boost revenue recovery in Europe. Overall, revenue and profit for the third and fourth quarters are expected to grow double‑digit percentages year over year.
Vision Sun opened the morning session at 205 NT, peaked at 212 NT, a rise of over 4%. By midday the share price was about 210 NT, up roughly 3.96%, with trading volume around 300 lots.

items.title: 〈焦點股〉貿聯財報利多出盡+資安事件影響 重挫跌停摜破月、季線
items.title_en: Focus Stock: TradeLink's Earnings Boom Exhausted, Cybersecurity Incident Drives Stock to 2050, Breaking Monthly, Quarterly, and Semi-Annual Lines
paras: 連接線大廠貿聯-KY(3665-TW)第二季獲利創高，上半年也來到同期最佳，但今(24)日股價利多出盡，加上發生網路安全事件影響，盤中出量重挫跌停來到2050元，摜破月、季及半年線。
貿聯今日上午公告，部分資訊系統遭受網路安全事件，公司於偵測到異常後，已立即啟動資安應變機制與隔離受影響之資訊系統措施，進行全面清查與復原作業，並同步委請外部資安專家協助復原與調查。
貿聯表示，經初步評估對公司整體營運及財務無重大影響，將持續提升網路與資訊基礎架構之資安防護姿態（security posture），以確保資料安全與營運韌性。
貿聯第二季營收232.81億元，季增11.59%、年增37.49%、毛利率30.73%，季增1.96個百分點、年減0.39個百分點、稅後純益29.82億元，季增31.13%、年增47.29%，每股純益15.28元。
貿聯上半年營收441.45億元，年增33.55%、毛利率29.80%，年減0.95個百分點；稅後純益52.56億元，年增44.52%，每股純益26.94元，均創歷史新高。
paras_en: TradeLink (KY 3665-TW), a major cable manufacturer, achieved record profits in Q2 and also hit a peak in the first half of the year, but on the 24th the stock’s upside was exhausted and a cybersecurity incident further triggered a sharp volume drop, sending the share price to a 20‑50‑point limit down at 2,050, breaking its monthly, quarterly, and half‑year lines.

TradeLink announced this morning that some of its information systems had been affected by a cybersecurity incident. Upon detecting anomalies, the company immediately activated its security response mechanisms and isolated the impacted systems, conducting a comprehensive audit and recovery, while also engaging external security experts to assist with restoration and investigation.

TradeLink stated that preliminary assessments indicate no significant impact on overall operations or finances, and it will continue to strengthen its cybersecurity posture for its network and information infrastructure to ensure data security and operational resilience.

TradeLink’s Q2 revenue was 23.281 billion NTD, up 11.59% quarter‑on‑quarter and 37.49% year‑on‑year, with a gross margin of 30.73%, up 1.96 percentage points quarter‑on‑quarter and down 0.39 percentage points year‑on‑year. Net profit after tax was 2.982 billion NTD, up 31.13% quarter‑on‑quarter and 47.29% year‑on‑year, translating to earnings per share of 15.28 NTD.

TradeLink’s first‑half revenue reached 44.145 billion NTD, up 33.55% year‑on‑year, with a gross margin of 29.80%, down 0.95 percentage points year‑on‑year. Net profit after tax was 5.256 billion NTD, up 44.52% year‑on‑year, yielding earnings per share of 26.94 NTD, all setting new historical highs.

工總今日舉行「2026年工總白皮書」發表記者會，現場匯聚工總監事召集人聯華(1229-TW)副董苗豐盛及4位副理事長暨產業大老皆到場主持與會。
針對調漲月薪將超過3萬元，潘俊榮在受訪時表示，只要企業有賺錢，為什麼要怕幫員工加薪?他認為受到AI及半導體產業表現優秀下，是政府稅收盈餘增加最堆，是政府「近39年以來最有錢的時候」，在企業有賺錢下，理應幫員工調漲薪資，他個人是相當支持，台灣在目前執政團隊領導下，也是目前是全東南亞發展最好的國家之一。
潘俊榮強調，政府資金有盈餘應該要全民共享，包括總統賴清德季芹也宣布明年要普發現金1萬元，就是與全民共享經濟成果。同時，企業若能讓經營成果由企業、員工及社會共同分享，從過去經驗來看，將能形成「三贏」局面，他認為企業若有賺錢，就應要與員工分享獲利。
但潘俊榮也提及示警，台灣絕不能只有AI，傳統產業仍是台灣產業的磐石，目前傳統產業面臨許多困境，包括缺工、缺人、薪資較低，政府應該要加強扶持傳產的力道，潘俊榮說，特別是現在國內建築業很冷，政府應將資源轉向並關注在傳產上。
對於國內能源政策部分，潘俊榮則建議政府採納多元能源政策，讓企業對於供電憂慮就不會那麼大，加上能源管理法若能修法讓用電大戶自設電廠，也讓能源政策穩定，尤其是核二、核三廠應準備重啟，讓台灣能源更穩定且能夠多元化發展，潘俊榮認為「產業不怕挑戰，就怕不穩定」，工總希望政府能重新檢視國家能源政策的適宜性。
工總每年都針對政府政策提出白皮書建言，今年工總白皮書，針對缺工、產業轉型、能源政策產業最關切的三大議題向政府提出建言，工總每年均獲政府高度重視，去年提出的建言高達75%被政府採納執行，成為行政部門與工總重要的對話平台。
paras_en: The Federation of Labor held a press conference this morning (the 24th) to release the "2026 Federation White Paper." Regarding the upcoming review of the minimum monthly wage for 2027, Chairman Pan Jun‑rong said that as long as industries are profitable, the business community will fully support the government’s policies. He also warned that Taiwan’s economy is overly tilted toward technology and semiconductors, and highlighted the current difficulties faced by traditional sectors, urging that Taiwan should not rely solely on AI and that the government should allocate resources to traditional industries to promote balanced capital development across sectors.

The Federation’s press conference for the "2026 Federation White Paper" was attended by Federation convenor Lianhua (ticker 1229‑TW) Vice Chairman Miao Feng‑sheng and four vice‑chairmen, all prominent industry veterans, who chaired the event.

Commenting on the proposed wage increase to over NT$30,000, Pan Jun‑rong said that if companies are making profits, there is no reason to fear giving employees higher pay. He noted that strong performance in AI and the semiconductor sector has boosted tax revenues, making this the richest period for the government in the past 39 years, and therefore companies should raise salaries. He expressed personal support and said Taiwan, under the current administration, is now one of the best‑developing economies in Southeast Asia.

Pan emphasized that surplus government funds should be shared with all citizens, citing President Lai Ching‑te’s announcement to distribute a NT$10,000 cash payment to everyone next year as an example of sharing economic gains. He added that when companies share their earnings with employees and society, a "win‑win‑win" outcome can be achieved, and that profitable firms have an obligation to share profits with their workers.

However, Pan warned that Taiwan cannot rely solely on AI; traditional industries remain the backbone of the economy. These sectors face challenges such as labor shortages, low wages, and a lack of talent. He called for stronger government support for traditional manufacturing, especially noting the current slump in the domestic construction industry and urging a shift of resources toward these sectors.

On energy policy, Pan suggested the government adopt a diversified energy mix so that companies are less concerned about power supply. He advocated amending the Energy Management Act to allow large electricity users to build their own power plants and urged the preparation for restarting the second and third nuclear plants, arguing that stable, diversified energy is essential because "industries fear instability, not challenges." The Federation hopes the government will re‑examine the suitability of national energy policies.

Each year the Federation issues a white‑paper with policy recommendations. This year’s paper focuses on three key concerns: labor shortages, industrial transformation, and energy policy. The Federation’s suggestions are highly regarded by the government; last year, 75% of its recommendations were adopted, making it an important dialogue platform between the administration and the labor organization.

items.title: 泵浦重油洩漏引燃！大林煉油廠深夜火警已撲滅 中油緊急調度確保用油無虞
items.title_en: Heavy Fuel Oil Pump Leak Ignites! Dalin Refinery Night Fire Extinguished, CPC Corp. Mobilizes Emergency Dispatch to Ensure Oil Supply Security
paras: 台灣中油大林煉油廠第11蒸餾工場昨（23）日夜間發生泵浦重油洩漏火警，經廠內消防隊與高雄市消防局全力搶救，火勢於當晚23時15分撲滅，全案無人傷亡。台灣中油對造成周邊居民不便致歉，並於今(24) 日上午啟動事故調查與災損評估，同時展開生產調度規劃，強調將妥善安排國內用油供應，確保市場穩定無虞，後續亦將強化設備預防性維護以降低故障風險。
台灣中油大林煉油廠第11蒸餾工場於昨23日21時45分許，因P110泵浦重油洩漏引發火警。工場值班人員發現後立即通報，並依照標準作業程序停止工場進料、改為循環作業。大林煉油廠隨即啟動緊急應變機制，廠內消防隊及相關支援人員於第一時間趕赴現場進行處置，高雄市政府消防隊亦於22時12分入廠協助支援警戒。
在多方全力搶救下，現場火勢於23時15分順利撲滅，確認無任何人員傷亡。火勢撲滅後，廠內消防隊與現場工作人員持續進行警戒降溫作業，防止復燃情事發生。
針對本次事故，台灣中油煉製事業部大林煉油廠於今24日上午召開事故調查檢討會議，針對受災損區域進行實地調查與復原評估，並同步制定生產調度應變規劃。台灣中油指出，公司正與高雄市政府保持密切聯繫，確保資訊公開透明。
台灣中油強調，未來將持續強化設備巡檢及預防性維護工作，並依據最終事故調查結果落實各項改善措施，切實降低設備故障所衍生之風險。針對市場關心的供油問題，台灣中油表示已做好妥善調度安排，國內各項用油供應無虞，請國人放心。
paras_en: On the night of the 23rd, a heavy fuel oil pump leak and fire broke out at CPC Corp.’s Dalin Refinery 11th distillation unit. The plant’s fire brigade and the Kaohsiung City Fire Department fought the blaze, which was extinguished at 23:15, with no injuries or fatalities. CPC Corp. apologized for the inconvenience to nearby residents, launched an accident investigation and damage assessment on the morning of the 24th, and began production scheduling to assure domestic oil supply and market stability, while pledging to strengthen preventive maintenance to reduce future failures.

At around 21:45 on the 23rd, the P110 heavy‑fuel‑oil pump at the 11th distillation unit of CPC Corp.’s Dalin Refinery leaked, triggering a fire. The on‑duty staff reported the incident immediately and, following standard procedures, halted feedstock intake and switched to a recirculation mode. The refinery activated its emergency response plan, dispatching its internal fire team and support personnel, while the Kaohsiung City government fire brigade arrived at 22:12 to assist and secure the site.

Through coordinated rescue efforts, the fire was fully extinguished by 23:15, with no casualties confirmed. After the fire was out, the plant’s fire team and on‑site workers continued monitoring and cooling operations to prevent any re‑ignition.

On the morning of the 24th, CPC Corp.’s Refining Business Unit held an accident investigation and review meeting for the Dalin Refinery, conducting on‑site inspections and damage assessments of the affected area and formulating a production scheduling response plan. The company said it is maintaining close communication with the Kaohsiung municipal government to ensure transparent information sharing.

CPC Corp. emphasized that it will keep enhancing equipment inspections and preventive maintenance, and will implement improvement measures based on the final investigation findings to reduce equipment‑failure risks. Regarding market concerns about oil supply, the company assured that it has arranged proper dispatches and that domestic oil supply remains secure, urging the public not to worry.

items.title: 散裝航運旺季將至 估運價有望維持高檔至年底
items.title_en: Bulk Shipping Season Approaches, Freight Rates Expected to Stay High Until Year-End
paras: 散裝運價維持高檔，部分航商上半年獲利明顯倍增，近一個月來雖處相對淡季，因有效運力供給偏緊，仍支撐海岬型船舶(Capesize)運價走升，波羅的海海峽型指數(BCI)月漲逾15%，法人樂觀看待下半年旺季將使散裝市場供需更吃緊。
法人指出，儘管受到暑期淡季影響，澳洲與巴西鐵礦砂出貨量季減3.29%，惟長航程貨源增加，且有效運力供給增加有限，支撐海岬型船舶運價，展望後市，隨傳統旺季逐步來臨，鐵礦砂開始加強出貨帶動需求升溫。
中小型船方面，雖第三季以來運價大致持平，惟中東地緣政治推升煤炭運輸需求，且9月下旬開始進入北美穀物出口旺季，有助推升跨太平洋運輸動能。
同時，西非西芒度鐵礦區自去年第四季投產，上半年累計出貨量約 700 萬噸，隨西非雨季結束，第四季出貨量轉強，預估全年出貨量可望達 2000 萬噸；由於西非至中國航程較長，長航程貨源比重提升有助增加噸海浬需求。
整體來看，法人預料散裝市場運價有望一路維持高檔至年底。
paras_en: Bulk freight rates remain high, with some shipping companies seeing profits double in the first half of the year. Despite a relatively slow period over the past month, tight effective supply of shipping capacity continues to support rising Capesize freight rates, with the Baltic Capesize Index (BCI) up more than 15% this month, and institutional investors remain optimistic that the second half of the year will tighten supply and demand in the bulk market.

Institutional investors note that although the summer off‑season has reduced Australian and Brazilian iron ore shipments by 3.29% year‑on‑year, longer‑haul cargo supply has increased and effective capacity supply has risen only modestly, supporting Capesize freight rates. Looking ahead, as the traditional peak season gradually arrives, iron ore shipments are expected to ramp up, driving demand higher.

For mid‑size vessels, freight rates have largely held steady since the third quarter, but Middle Eastern geopolitical tensions have boosted coal transport demand, and the start of the North American grain export season in late September is helping to lift cross‑Pacific transport momentum.

Meanwhile, the West African Widemouth iron ore field began production in the fourth quarter of last year, with cumulative shipments of about 7 million tonnes in the first half of the year. As the West African rainy season ends, shipments in the fourth quarter are expected to strengthen, with an annual total projected at 20 million tonnes. Because the route from West Africa to China is long, the higher proportion of long‑haul cargo helps increase ton‑nautical mile demand.
Overall, institutional investors anticipate that bulk freight rates will remain at high levels through the end of the year.

items.title: 柏承南通新廠趕上光模塊mSAP製程需求 下半年也不看淡
items.title_en: Baicheng’s New Nantong Plant Meets Light Module mSAP Process Demand, No Downturn Expected in H2
paras: PCB 廠柏承 (6141-TW) 興建的江蘇南通新廠已經全部完工，同時，法人間在注意柏承南通廠建置的mSAP（改良型半加成製程，Modified Semi-Additive Process）趕上光通訊市場在光模塊的強大的需求，同時，預計在第四季800G產品產品將有好消息登場。
柏承在江蘇南通新廠效益正在挹注營運效益，除原有的中國品牌手機板訂單回流之外，柏承在江蘇南通新廠的原產能規劃設計上，早已光模塊的生產列爲開發重點項目，而在市場的台商臻鼎-KY(4958-TW)、華通(2313-TW)的mSAP製程產能有限，而法人指出，欣興(3037-TW)本身雖然具備mSAP的製程能力，但正忙碌於IC載板供不應求，也無暇顧及。
而來自柏承科技的南通廠在光模塊板也在向客戶端送樣，預計在第四季將有確切的結果。這也與柏承目前削減在消費性電子營收比重的營運路徑及方針相符。
柏承主管指出，在手機板訂單的增加之下，6 月營收比重中，南通廠營收躍升已和台灣的小量廠及樣品板廠合計的營收相當；同時，柏承科技的南通廠在光模塊板也在向客戶端送樣，預計在第四 季將有確切的結果。加上南通廠營運規模擴大，期待整體柏承業績發光。
柏承將辦理減資彌補虧損，預計將減資約 20.602%，並將進行私募現金增資案，有助於財務的健全。
paras_en: Baicheng PCB (6141‑TW) has completed its new plant in Nantong, Jiangsu, and the company is focusing on meeting the strong demand for light modules in the optical communications market with its improved semi‑additive process (mSAP). It is expected that the 800G product will make a significant announcement in the fourth quarter.

The new Nantong facility is already contributing to Baicheng’s operating efficiency. In addition to the return of orders for Chinese brand mobile phone boards, the plant’s original capacity plan has long prioritized light module production. Competitors such as Taiwanese companies Zhendong‑KY (4958‑TW) and Huahong (2313‑TW) have limited mSAP capacity, and although Xinxing (3037‑TW) possesses mSAP capability, it is busy with the high demand for IC substrates and cannot focus on this area.

Baicheng’s Nantong plant is also sending light module samples to customers, with definitive results expected in the fourth quarter. This aligns with Baicheng’s current strategy of reducing its share of consumer electronics revenue and adjusting its operational focus.

Baicheng’s management noted that with the increase in mobile phone board orders, the revenue share from the Nantong plant in June has risen to a level comparable to the combined revenue of small Taiwanese factories and sample board manufacturers. The Nantong plant is also sending light module samples to customers, with clear results anticipated in the fourth quarter. With the expansion of the Nantong plant’s operations, the company expects overall performance to shine.
Baicheng plans to reduce its capital to offset losses, with a planned capital reduction of about 20.602%, and will conduct a private placement cash injection to strengthen its financial health.

items.title: 創櫃板累計「吸金」73億元 櫃買攜手昕奇雲端跨足AI生態系26日登場
items.title_en: The ChiNext Board Has Raised a Total of 7.3 Billion New Taiwan Dollars; ChiNext and Xinqi Cloud Join Forces to Enter the AI Ecosystem on the 26th
paras: 櫃買中心攜手昕奇雲端公司 (7747-TW) 合作辦理「新創的 AI Transformation 轉型與成長」系列活動，協助中小微及新創企業發揮成長潛力。櫃買中心持續透過創櫃板、興櫃到上櫃的多層次市場架構，深化對新創生態系的支援與鏈結，創櫃板至今已成功協助企業累積募集73億元資金。本次系列活動以「AI × Startup × Cloud × Global」為主軸，首兩場論壇將分別於8月26日及9月4日假台北國際會議中心登場，期盼精準傳遞資本市場資源，吸引更多優質企業加入。
為持續協助中小微型企業與新創公司健全營運制度、提升品牌能見度與市場募資能力，櫃買中心長期打造完善的多層次資本市場架構。作為資本市場入口平台的創櫃板，成立11年以來成果斐然，截至115年7月底，已吸引290家企業登錄創櫃板，其中更有37家成功銜接公開發行、34家順利登錄興櫃，累計籌資金額高達73億元，成功驗證創櫃板銜接資本市場的強大樞紐功能。
除了創櫃板之外，櫃買中心的興櫃與上櫃主板同樣展現極強的資金吸引力與市場動能。截至115年7月底，登錄興櫃的企業達到359家，上櫃掛牌公司更高達890家。興櫃市場兼具輔導育成與籌資功能，並提供透明的價格發現機制，成為新創企業邁向主板前的關鍵預備市場；而上櫃主板則具備優異的成交值周轉率與高本益比兩大黃金優勢，市場資金動能充沛，能有效彰顯優質中小型企業的價值。

瞄準人工智慧技術浪潮與全球化布局的需求，以「A Friend to Startups (F2SU)」為核心主張的昕奇雲端公司，長期透過技術串聯、雲端資源與商務媒合，已與超過180家高成長新創公司建立深度合作關係。本次昕奇雲端特別邀請櫃買中心擔任指導單位，共同規劃「新創的 AI Transformation 轉型與成長」系列活動，聚焦AI技術落地、資本籌資與國際擴展等核心議題，攜手廣大新創生態系夥伴共襄盛舉。
本次系列活動首兩場【他山之石】教戰篇與【廣蓄糧草】籌資篇，將分別於115年8月26日及9月4日假台北國際會議中心舉行。活動將深入探討從技術落地到組織成長，以及從價值驗證到資本擴張的實戰經驗，期望藉由深化櫃買中心與新創生態系的跨界交流，向企業傳遞創櫃板與上興櫃市場的友善籌資環境，進一步提升優質新創登錄與申請進入台灣資本市場的意願。
paras_en: ChiNext Center partners with Xinqi Cloud (7747‑TW) to host the "AI Transformation for Startups" series, helping small, micro and startup companies unlock growth potential. Through its multi‑tier market structure—from ChiNext to the Emerging Board to the Main Board—ChiNext has deepened support for the startup ecosystem. To date, the ChiNext board has successfully helped companies raise 7.3 billion NT$ in capital. The series, centered on "AI × Startup × Cloud × Global," will hold its first two forums on August 26 and September 4 at the Taipei International Convention Center, aiming to precisely convey capital market resources and attract more high‑quality enterprises.

To continue supporting small, micro and startup companies in establishing sound operating systems, enhancing brand visibility and market fundraising capabilities, ChiNext Center has long been building a comprehensive multi‑tier capital market structure. As the entry platform of the capital market, ChiNext has achieved remarkable results in its 11 years of existence. By the end of July 2025, 290 companies had registered on ChiNext, including 37 that successfully connected to a public offering and 34 that successfully listed on the Emerging Board, raising a cumulative 7.3 billion NT$ and proving ChiNext’s powerful role as a hub linking to the capital market.

Beyond ChiNext, the Emerging Board and the Main Board of ChiNext Center also demonstrate strong capital attraction and market momentum. By the end of July 2025, 359 companies had listed on the Emerging Board, while 890 companies were listed on the Main Board. The Emerging Board market combines incubation and fundraising functions and offers a transparent price discovery mechanism, becoming a key preparatory market for startups before moving to the Main Board. The Main Board boasts excellent turnover of transaction value and high price‑to‑earnings ratios, providing ample market momentum to effectively showcase the value of high‑quality small and medium enterprises.

Targeting the wave of artificial intelligence technology and the need for global expansion, Xinqi Cloud, which champions "A Friend to Startups (F2SU)", has long connected technology, cloud resources and business matchmaking. It has established deep partnerships with over 180 high‑growth startups. Xinqi Cloud has specially invited ChiNext Center to serve as a guiding unit, jointly planning the "AI Transformation for Startups" series to focus on AI technology implementation, capital fundraising and international expansion, and to collaborate with a broad ecosystem of startup partners.

The first two events of the series, "Heavenly Stone Tactical Edition" and "Broad Grain Storage Fundraising Edition", will be held on August 26 and September 4, 2025, at the Taipei International Convention Center. The events will delve into practical experiences from technology implementation to organizational growth, and from value validation to capital expansion. By deepening cross‑sector exchanges between ChiNext Center and the startup ecosystem, the aim is to convey the friendly fundraising environment of ChiNext and the Emerging Board markets to enterprises, further enhancing the willingness of high‑quality startups to register and apply to enter Taiwan’s capital market.

items.title: 美債突破40兆美元「不會崩盤」？大摩示警：真正風險在股債資金轉向
paras: 摩根士丹利(MS-US)認為，40兆美元美債本身並不代表美國經濟即將陷入危機，真正需要關注的，是高債務環境是否最終改變投資人的股債配置，以及企業獲利成長能否持續支撐目前的資產估值。
美國聯邦債務規模突破40兆美元，市場對財政壓力與經濟前景的擔憂升溫。不過，摩根士丹利 全球固定收益研究主管Andrew Sheets認為，高額政府債務確實可能限制經濟活動，但目前還不足以引發系統性崩潰，企業與家庭資產負債表持續改善，將成為重要緩衝。
Sheets在最新報告指出，美國聯邦債務過去10年增加20兆美元，僅最近3個月就增加超過1兆美元。與此同時，全球主要經濟體的政府債務占GDP比重普遍攀升。
值得注意的是，政府部門槓桿上升的同時，美國企業與家庭部門的財務狀況並未同步惡化。
Sheets認為，這項結構性差異代表政府債務對實體經濟造成的衝擊，可能低於市場目前的擔憂。

企業發債創新高　但槓桿率未明顯惡化

摩根士丹利指出，受到科技支出增加及併購活動回溫帶動，美國企業債券發行規模持續創新高，信用策略團隊預期，今年全年發行量可能再次刷新紀錄。
但Sheets認為，企業大舉發債本身並不代表系統性風險正在累積。過去10年，美國企業債務占GDP比率大致持平，且低於疫情前水準。
其中，超大規模科技企業（hyperscaler）的槓桿率仍相對偏低，加上AI投資帶來的報酬率，使企業承擔較高融資成本仍具有一定合理性。
報告因此預期，即使殖利率持續走高，也不至於立即中斷企業融資，信用利差則可能僅溫和擴大。

美國家庭負債降至GDP的67%

家庭部門的財務狀況同樣提供一定支撐。報告顯示，美國家庭債務目前約占GDP的67%，低於2000年的約70%與2019年的74%。
值得注意的是，家庭債務占比下降並不代表家庭完全不受高利率環境影響。Sheets指出，美國許多房貸早已在過去低利率時期完成固定，且房價等家庭資產價值上升，讓家庭整體財務狀況獲得一定支撐，也有助於消費維持韌性。
不過，房市等高度依賴利率的領域已受到明顯壓抑，因此利率變化對家庭支出的影響，可能需要更長時間才會充分反映。
這種「政府加槓桿、私人部門改善資產負債表」的現象也出現在其他主要經濟體。歐洲部分國家政府債務占GDP比重提高之際，企業與家庭反而持續降低負債；日本雖然公共部門借貸增加，私人部門的槓桿程度卻大致維持穩定。
Sheets認為，這與各國過去的政策選擇有關，包括美國、法國、日本、瑞典、瑞士、義大利及英國在過去10年均曾降低稅率，使公共部門財務狀況相對私人部門出現更明顯的惡化。

真正風險可能在股債資金重新配置

相較於企業停止借貸或家庭大幅削減消費，Sheets認為，高額政府債務真正可能對金融市場造成衝擊的關鍵，在於投資人是否開始認為債券相較股票具有更具吸引力的風險報酬。
報告指出，目前美國30年期國債殖利率比預期通膨高出約300個基點，長天期美國投資級公司債殖利率則達6.2%。
然而，目前資金流向及股債價格關係仍未顯示出明顯的資產重新配置跡象。近期股票與債券價格仍呈現同向波動，尚未出現資金大規模從股市轉向債市的明確訊號。
在這種環境下，企業獲利成長成為維持市場穩定的重要因素。年初至今標普500指數上漲約13%，同期美國10年期國債殖利率上升約50個基點，但股票風險溢價大致維持穩定。
Sheets將目前環境與1990年代末期的市場狀況進行比較，並警告，一旦企業獲利成長開始放緩，市場脆弱性可能明顯升高。

摩根士丹利看好英國抗通膨債、澳元

在全球財政狀況分化之際，摩根士丹利也提出部分相對具吸引力的市場。
報告指出，英國是少數預期財政赤字將收窄的主要經濟體之一，因此該行看好英國通膨掛鉤債券。
此外，澳洲政府債務占GDP比率僅約49%，加上相對較高的利差收益，使澳元也受到青睞。
相較之下，Sheets對美元前景持較謹慎態度。他認為，如果美國財政部進一步介入長天期利率，可能對美元形成壓力，同時美國國債殖利率曲線7年至30年期區段可能重新趨於陡峭。

items.title: 《大賣空》貝瑞拋售阿里巴巴、稱「股價太貴」！轉手買入「這一股」
items.title_en: Michael Burry Sells Alibaba, Calls Its Stock Too Expensive, Switches to JD
paras: 以押注美國房市崩盤聞名的《大賣空》原型投資人貝瑞（Michael Burry）批評阿里巴巴(09988-HK) 股價估值過高，並透露自己近期已退出這家中國科技巨頭的持股，轉而在其競爭對手京東集團(09618-HK) 建立一筆「大額」持倉。
根據《彭博》報導，貝瑞在Substack發文表示，他原本計畫在一、兩個月後將大部分資金重新投入阿里巴巴，但如今已改變想法。他指出，除非阿里巴巴股價跌至目前的一半，否則他不會重新產生投資興趣。
貝瑞是Scion Capital Management創辦人，因在2008年全球金融危機前押注美國房市下跌而成名。
他此次發表上述看法之際，阿里巴巴才宣布計畫透過發行新股籌集約800億港元（約102億美元），為AI投資提供資金。若完成，這將成為香港市場有史以來規模最大的上市公司增發集資案。
對於阿里巴巴透過發行新股籌資的做法，貝瑞直言自己「我無法認同發行新股這件事」，並預期公司投入資本報酬率仍將持續下滑。
阿里巴巴近期公布截至6月底的季度財報，獲利較去年同期大幅下滑75%。隨著公司加大AI相關資本支出，進一步加劇了投資者對中國科技業未來回報的擔憂。
股價表現同樣承受壓力。阿里巴巴美國存託憑證(BABA-US) 今年以來累計下跌18.6%，僅上週五（21日）單日就下挫8.6%；在香港掛牌的阿里巴巴股價今年迄今也下跌13.9%。
值得注意的是，貝瑞今年4月才透露建立阿里巴巴的新持倉。
阿里巴巴則在週日（23日）另行宣布，此次增發新股的定價為每股112.70港元，相較之下，香港股市上週五收盤價為123港元。
（本文不開放合作夥伴轉載）
paras_en: Michael Burry, the original investor behind the book "The Big Short" known for betting on the collapse of the U.S. housing market, criticized Alibaba Group Holding Ltd. (09988-HK) for being overvalued and revealed that he has recently exited his holdings in the Chinese tech giant, instead building a large position in its competitor JD.com (09618-HK).

According to Bloomberg, Burry wrote on Substack that he had originally planned to reinvest most of his capital back into Alibaba in one or two months, but has now changed his mind. He said he would not be interested in re-entering the company unless its stock price fell to about half of its current level.
Burry is the founder of Scion Capital Management and became famous for betting on the decline of the U.S. housing market before the 2008 global financial crisis.

At the time Burry made these remarks, Alibaba had just announced plans to raise about HK$80 billion (US$10.2 billion) by issuing new shares to fund AI investments. If completed, it would be the largest share‑issuance capital‑raising deal ever in the Hong Kong market.
Regarding Alibaba’s new‑share issuance, Burry said, “I cannot endorse the act of issuing new shares,” and expects the company’s capital‑return rate to continue to decline.

Alibaba recently released its Q2 2024 earnings, showing a 75% drop in profit year‑on‑year. The company’s increased AI‑related capital expenditures have further heightened investors’ concerns about the future returns of Chinese technology firms.

The stock has also been under pressure. Alibaba’s U.S. Depositary Receipts (BABA‑US) have fallen 18.6% year‑to‑date, dropping 8.6% on Friday the 21st; the Hong Kong‑listed Alibaba shares have fallen 13.9% so far this year.
It is worth noting that Burry only disclosed his new Alibaba position in April of this year.
Alibaba announced on Sunday the 23rd that the new share issuance would be priced at HK$112.70 per share, compared with the Hong Kong market closing price of HK$123 on Friday.
