items.title: 標普500恐跌15%至20%？策略師警告：美債殖利率逼近5%恐引爆股市「去風險」
items.title_en: S&P 500 Could Fall 15% to 20%? Strategists Warn: Near‑5% Treasury Yields May Trigger Market 'Risk‑Off'
paras: 若美國長天期公債殖利率持續走高，市場情勢可能很快進一步惡化。市場研究機構MRB Partners全球策略合夥人Phillip Colmar警告，若10年期美債殖利率持續走高，標普500指數甚至可能回落15%至20%。
根據《Business Insider》報導，Colmar本週在給客戶的報告中指出，長天期美債殖利率的上升，已讓股市處於爆發一波「去風險」行情的臨界點。
上週10年期美債殖利率一度升破4.7%，30年期殖利率也突破5.2%。債券投資人日益擔心政府債務持續攀升、經濟成長預期強勁，以及美伊戰爭持續帶來的通膨壓力。
Colmar上週五（21日）表示，如果長天期公債殖利率持續走高，10年期殖利率接近5%大關，可能讓投資人受到驚嚇，進而引發標普500指數下跌15%至20%。
談到10年期公債殖利率時，他表示：「只要市場看起來殖利率還會繼續上升，而且沒有任何力量能阻止它，就可能在殖利率突破5%之前，引發一波去風險事件。」
Colmar目前並未預測美債殖利率下一步確切走勢，但他表示，目前投資立場仍偏向支持經濟成長。
不過，他指出，美國財政部本週試圖壓低長天期公債殖利率的措施，反而可能適得其反，導致殖利率進一步走高。
美國財政部長貝森特（Scott Bessent）日前表示，財政部將擴大公債回購規模，藉此降低市場上的債券供給，希望進一步壓低殖利率。
但Colmar認為，這項措施可能讓市場產生一種印象，即川普政府試圖壓低公債殖利率，卻沒有處理殖利率上升的根本原因，也就是市場對通膨的疑慮。
Colmar表示，由於這項措施並未與聯準會（Fed）協調，也可能向市場釋放出財政部正在恐慌的訊號。聯準會此前已表示，希望讓所持政府公債到期後自然退出資產負債表。
Colmar表示，市場很容易察覺到政策制定者的「恐慌」。

為何美債殖利率上升會打擊股市？

長天期美債殖利率走高對股市的衝擊，主要來自兩個層面。
首先，殖利率上升通常會對成長型股票造成壓力。原因在於，投資人會將長期公債所提供的無風險報酬率，與股票市場未來具有不確定性的長期報酬進行比較。
由於目前市場很大一部分估值建立在AI將提升生產力的長期預期上，一旦AI交易陷入停滯，可能進一步拖累整體市場。
其次，政府公債殖利率上升也會影響AI企業的借貸成本。這些企業目前正投入大量資本建設AI基礎設施，而更高的融資成本將壓縮投資資本的整體報酬率，並降低企業獲利。
Colmar表示，AI企業目前承受著巨大的投資變現壓力，市場對其未來獲利的預期也已非常高。若借貸成本持續上升，企業實現市場預期的投資回報所需時間將被拉長，將促使投資人下修獲利預期，並要求企業更加嚴格控管資本支出，進而導致股價下跌。
他表示：「最終可能形成一個預期落差：AI本身或許仍是一個不錯的題材，但市場預期實在太高，企業如今已無法達到這些預期。」
對於擔心公債殖利率進一步上升的投資人，Colmar也提出幾項可以強化投資組合的策略。
其中一項做法是降低AI股票的曝險，同時增加防禦型產業的配置，例如醫療保健類股。相較於其他傳統防禦型產業，醫療保健類股通常對利率變化的敏感度較低。
此外，他表示，金融類股在利率走高的環境下通常也有較佳表現。
可用於布局上述投資方向的基金，包括先鋒醫療股指數ETF(VHT-US) 及SPDR 金融類股ETF(XLF-US) 。
paras_en: If U.S. long‑term Treasury yields continue to rise, market conditions could deteriorate rapidly. MRB Partners global strategist Phillip Colmar warned that if the 10‑year Treasury yield keeps climbing, the S&P 500 could fall 15% to 20%.
According to Business Insider, Colmar noted in a client report this week that the rise in long‑term Treasury yields has pushed the market to the brink of a 'risk‑off' wave.

Last week the 10‑year Treasury yield briefly breached 4.7%, and the 30‑year yield surpassed 5.2%. Bond investors are increasingly worried about rising government debt, strong growth expectations, and ongoing inflationary pressure from the U.S.–Iran conflict.
Colmar said on Friday (the 21st) that if long‑term Treasury yields keep climbing and the 10‑year yield nears the 5% threshold, investors could be shocked, triggering a 15% to 20% drop in the S&P 500.
When discussing the 10‑year Treasury yield, he said: 'If the market believes yields will keep rising and nothing can stop them, a risk‑off event could erupt before the 5% barrier is breached.'
Colmar does not yet predict the exact next move of Treasury yields, but he remains supportive of economic growth in his current investment stance.
However, he pointed out that the Treasury's recent attempts to lower long‑term yields may backfire, pushing yields higher.
Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent recently said the Treasury would expand bond repurchase programs to reduce supply and lower yields.
But Colmar believes this move may create the impression that the Trump administration is trying to suppress yields without addressing the root cause—market concerns about inflation.

Colmar noted that because this measure was not coordinated with the Fed, it could signal Treasury panic to the market. The Fed has previously said it intends to let held government bonds mature and exit the balance sheet naturally.
Colmar said markets are quick to detect policymakers' 'panic'.
Why rising Treasury yields hurt the stock market? The impact of long‑term yields on equities comes from two main angles.
First, rising yields typically pressure growth stocks. Investors compare the risk‑free return from long‑term bonds to the uncertain long‑term returns of the equity market.
Because a large portion of current valuations is built on the expectation that AI will boost productivity, a slowdown in AI trading could further drag down the overall market.

Second, higher Treasury yields also raise borrowing costs for AI firms. These companies are investing heavily in AI infrastructure, and higher financing costs compress overall investment returns and reduce profitability.

Colmar said AI firms are under significant pressure to monetize investments, and market expectations for their future earnings are already very high. If borrowing costs continue to rise, the time needed to achieve expected returns lengthens, prompting investors to cut earnings forecasts and demand tighter capital discipline, leading to falling stock prices.
He added: 'Ultimately, a gap may form between expectations and reality: AI may still be a good theme, but the market's expectations are too high for firms to meet.'
For investors worried about further yield increases, Colmar suggested several strategies to strengthen portfolios.

One approach is to reduce exposure to AI stocks while increasing allocation to defensive sectors, such as healthcare. Compared to other traditional defensive industries, healthcare stocks are generally less sensitive to interest rate changes.
Additionally, he noted that financial stocks tend to perform better in a rising‑rate environment.
Funds that can be used to position toward these investment themes include the Vanguard Health Care ETF (VHT-US) and the SPDR Financial Select Sector ETF (XLF-US).

items.title: 7月行情再現？高盛：儲存股價獲利「落差大」最具吸引力  金融、黃金銅礦成新寵
paras: 人工智慧（AI）投資熱潮近期出現新的變化。高盛(GS-US) 警告，AI交易開始出現裂痕，投資人需要留意部分AI相關股票的股價漲幅，已經與企業每股盈餘（EPS）表現出現越來越大的落差。與此同時，市場資金也開始轉向過去較少受到關注的領域，包括歐洲與日本銀行股、黃金礦商及銅礦股，都逐漸成為市場新的焦點。
高盛交易員Natasha Tiwana將上週行情形容為典型的「去槓桿行情」，市場跌勢之快，也讓原本認為7月股市拋售已經告一段落的投資人措手不及。
高盛高貝塔動量組合上週下跌12%，AI對沖組合5個交易日則下跌10%。
高盛指出，這次動量股大跌的原因，與7月行情有不少相似之處。雖然AI相關交易的槓桿程度已經從極端高點下降，但市場仍存在大量資金採取「逢低買進」策略，導致部分股票在下跌後迅速出現大量買盤。
不過，高盛認為，這波投資人調整持股、降低風險，搭配AI產業基本面仍然強勁，反而可能替市場9月重新承擔風險創造更健康的環境。

AI投資邏輯改變 儲存、資料中心成高盛首選

高盛認為，AI交易並沒有結束，但投資人現在關注的重點正在改變。
過去市場主要關注「哪些公司能從AI大規模資本支出中受惠」，如今隨著AI運算成本持續下降，投資人開始進一步尋找「哪些公司能真正從AI普及中賺到錢」。
在短線操作上，高盛建議投資人尋找股價表現與企業獲利之間存在明顯落差的股票。
其中，儲存與資料中心兩大板塊尤其受到高盛關注。高盛指出，這些公司的獲利預期已經改善，但股價似乎還沒有完全反映這些變化，因此存在戰術性投資機會。
接下來，輝達(NVDA-US) 第二季財報將成為市場重要觀察焦點，9月接連登場的產業會議，也可能進一步提供AI產業新的投資訊號。
另一方面，AI應用也開始受到更多關注。上週，莫德納(MRNA-US) 與默克藥廠(MRK-US) 宣布合作開發AI輔助藥物，帶動市場對AI醫療與AI藥物研發領域的興趣。
高盛數據顯示，醫療AI相關受惠企業的獲利預期正在改善，專業投資人的態度也開始轉趨正面，進一步吸引更多投資人關注AI藥物研發。

動量股正在換人！軟體取代半導體

高盛指出，市場熱門股的排名也正在快速洗牌。數據顯示，2026年動量因子單日跌幅超過5%的次數，已經超過過去5年的總和。
更值得注意的是，過去一年表現強勢的股票，與最近3個月強勢股的重疊程度已降至多年低點；反過來，過去一年強勢股與最近3個月弱勢股的重疊程度，卻接近歷史高點。
簡單來說，過去一年最熱門的股票，最近反而開始成為市場上的弱勢股。
從市場結構來看，軟體股已取代半導體，成為3個月動量多頭組合中權重最高的產業；半導體與AI相關股票則已轉向空頭組合，顯示市場正在尋找下一批領漲族群。

歐日銀行股崛起 高盛看好後市

高盛認為，市場重新評估聯準會（Fed）可能維持高利率更長時間後，歐洲與日本銀行股的吸引力正在提高。
除了利率環境之外，高盛也看好歐日銀行的其他收入來源，包括手續費收入成長、營運效率改善，以及股利與股票回購等股東回饋，都可能成為銀行股的支撐。
日本銀行股過去3個月已經同時跑贏東證指數與日本半導體類股，而且股價波動相對較低。高盛認為，黏性通膨與升息預期仍可能支持日本銀行股後市表現。
歐洲方面，整體銀行股目前相較美國銀行股仍有約15%的估值折價。
高盛最看好歐洲的希臘銀行股，認為相關銀行估值正在向歐元區核心國家的同業靠攏，但目前仍有約10%的折價，加上潛在併購題材，仍有進一步上漲空間。
值得注意的是，目前歐洲銀行股的投資人持股比例已降至兩年來低點，進一步強化了其配置價值。

黃金、銅礦股也有補漲機會

除了銀行股，高盛也看好黃金與銅等硬資產相關股票。
高盛先前就看好黃金礦商，理由包括中國需求回升，以及市場對聯準會降息的預期升溫。黃金礦商相關組合本月以來已上漲32%，但距離歷史高點仍有約12%的差距。目前本益比約11倍，仍比過去5年平均水準低約20%。
高盛認為，美國財政部擴大公債回購計畫可能推動美元走弱，進而成為黃金礦商下一階段上漲的推力。同時，地緣政治風險持續，也可能讓更多投資人將黃金視為年底前的避險工具。
銅市場同樣受到高盛關注。受到美國關稅風險，以及美國以外地區供應偏緊的支撐，銅價上週一度創下歷史新高。
不過，主要受到中東局勢升溫，以及市場資金過度集中AI交易的影響，銅礦股自2月以來的表現卻一直落後銅價，與其獲利基本面並不相稱。
高盛指出，從供需來看，銅市場仍受到供應緊張支撐；另一方面，7月聯準會會議紀要顯示，目前升息仍缺乏多數支持。如果市場重新預期聯準會政策轉向鴿派，工業金屬可能因此受惠，銅礦股也有機會追上銅價與企業獲利的表現。

高盛提醒：法國政治風險可能被市場低估

除了產業與資金輪動，高盛也提醒另一項市場風險：法國政治局勢。
今年夏季以來，市場看空法國國債的部位持續增加，法國與德國國債利差（OAT-Bund）已擴大至約85個基點，創下階段性新高。
不過，法國股市先前對政治風險的反應並不明顯，直到最近幾天才開始出現波動。
高盛認為，目前法國股市估值已經位於近5年90%分位的高檔，但市場尚未充分反映政治不確定性可能帶來的風險。
接下來幾項政治相關活動值得關注，包括8月27日法國企業主聯合會（Medef）夏季年會，以及8月30日司法部長Darmanin的夏季聚會。
從歷史經驗來看，法國國內股票對政治風險的反應比法國CAC 40指數更加敏感。一旦政治不確定性升高，相關股票與信用利差的連動也會更加明顯，意味著目前高檔估值可能面臨進一步修正壓力。

items.title: 川普向習近平釋善意？美政府傳考慮放行蘋果採購中國長鑫科技記憶體
items.title_en: Trump Extends Olive Branch to Xi? US Government Mulls Allowing Apple to Buy Memory Chips from China’s ChangXin Technology
paras: 最新市場消息指出，川普政府可能考慮允許蘋果(AAPL-US) 向中國長鑫科技(688825-CN) 及長江存儲採購記憶體與儲存晶片，相關決定甚至可能在美國總統川普與中國國家主席習近平9月會面後正式對外傳達。
根據《Wccftech》報導，在習近平正式訪美前夕，蘋果分別向中國長鑫科技及長江存儲採購DRAM與NAND模組的計畫，已成為美中地緣政治角力的敏感焦點。
近期已有消息指出，蘋果正測試長鑫科技的DRAM產品，以及長江存儲的NAND模組，顯示兩家中國記憶體業者進入蘋果供應鏈的可能性正在升高。
不過，若合作最終成行，相關中國供應商提供的記憶體產品將僅用於蘋果在中國市場銷售的產品。
根據《金融時報》近日報導，蘋果甚至已積極向川普政府遊說，希望取得向長鑫科技採購DRAM的許可。長鑫科技目前仍因被認為與中國人民解放軍存在關聯，而列在美國五角大廈的黑名單上。
《彭博》記者古爾曼（Mark Gurman）先前也透露，蘋果正與川普政府協商，希望降低未來若採用長鑫科技及長江存儲記憶體後，可能在美國政府引發的政治反彈。
蘋果近來也已公開釋出對中國記憶體供應商的興趣。在最新財報電話會議上，公司表示仍在評估不同的供應來源，並認為採用更多供應商可能有助於改善供應狀況，至於成本方面是否能帶來幫助，目前仍無法確定。
如今，微博爆料帳號「Mobile Chip Expert」更進一步指出，川普政府可能準備批准蘋果分別從長鑫科技及長江存儲採購記憶體與儲存晶片，正式通知可能會在川普與習近平9月一對一會談後發布。
不過，目前這項說法仍屬市場消息，最終是否真的獲得美方批准，仍有待觀察。
這項潛在政策調整也已引發美國國會部分議員反彈。近期已有一批美國國會議員要求蘋果放棄採用中國來源的記憶體，並要求公司在8月21日前承諾不推動相關計畫，並同時揭露其曾與長鑫科技、長江存儲分享的任何技術資訊。
即使川普政府最終放行，長鑫科技是否具備立即滿足蘋果DRAM需求的能力，仍存在疑問。先前已有消息指出，長鑫科技目前產能受到限制。
另一方面，近期消息指出，即使雙方建立商業合作關係，長鑫科技也拒絕向蘋果提供任何價格讓步。
paras_en: The latest market reports indicate that the Trump administration may be considering permitting Apple (AAPL-US) to purchase memory and storage chips from China’s ChangXin Technology (688825-CN) and Yangtze Memory (YMTC), with a decision possibly being publicly announced after President Trump’s September meeting with Chinese President Xi Jinping.

According to Wccftech, Apple’s plans to buy DRAM from ChangXin and NAND modules from Yangtze Memory just before Xi’s official visit to the United States have become a sensitive flashpoint in the US‑China geopolitical rivalry.
Recent reports say Apple is testing ChangXin’s DRAM products and Yangtze Memory’s NAND modules, suggesting that the two Chinese memory makers are increasingly likely to enter Apple’s supply chain.
However, if the cooperation materialises, the memory products supplied by the Chinese vendors would be used only in Apple devices sold in the Chinese market.

The Financial Times recently reported that Apple has even been actively lobbying the Trump administration for permission to buy DRAM from ChangXin, which remains on the U.S. Pentagon’s blacklist due to alleged ties to the People’s Liberation Army.

Bloomberg reporter Mark Gurman previously disclosed that Apple is negotiating with the Trump administration to mitigate any political backlash in the United States that could arise if it adopts memory from ChangXin and Yangtze Memory.

Apple has also publicly expressed interest in Chinese memory suppliers. In its latest earnings call, the company said it is still evaluating different sources and believes that adding more suppliers could improve supply conditions, though it cannot yet say whether costs would benefit.

Now a Weibo account called “Mobile Chip Expert” has gone further, claiming the Trump administration may be preparing to approve Apple’s purchases of memory and storage chips from both ChangXin and Yangtze Memory, with formal notification possibly coming after Trump’s one‑on‑one talks with Xi in September.
Nevertheless, this remains a market rumor, and whether the United States will ultimately grant approval is still uncertain.

The potential policy shift has already sparked pushback from some U.S. lawmakers. A group of members of Congress recently urged Apple to abandon any Chinese‑sourced memory, demanding the company commit by August 21 not to pursue the plan and to disclose any technical information it may have shared with ChangXin or Yangtze Memory.

Even if the Trump administration ultimately green‑lights the deal, doubts remain about whether ChangXin can immediately meet Apple’s DRAM needs, as earlier reports suggest the company’s production capacity is currently constrained.
On the other hand, recent news indicates that even if a commercial relationship is established, ChangXin has refused to offer Apple any price concessions.

items.title: AI概念股還能漲？Evercore點名「6大」硬體股：2026年下半年將進一步走高
items.title_en: Can AI Concept Stocks Still Rise? Evercore Names Six Hardware Stocks Set to Climb Further in Late 2026
paras: 人工智慧（AI）硬體支出持續強勁，帶動部分科技股今年大幅上漲。Evercore ISI分析師Amit Daryanani認為，部分今年表現最亮眼的科技股，進入2026年下半年後仍有進一步走高的空間。
根據《MarketWatch》報導，Daryanani近日公布下半年「最值得持有的6檔股票」名單，其中包括儲存設備與資料中心網路供應商。他指出，AI硬體支出強勁，已讓相關企業成為今年科技股市場的重要受惠者。
在儲存設備領域，基於硬碟（HDD）需求持續強勁，Daryanani及其團隊看好希捷科技(STX-US) 與威騰電子(WDC-US) 的後市表現。
Daryanani指出，在儲存產品供應持續吃緊的情況下，希捷科技的定價能力有望進一步提升。
此外，隨著希捷科技的Mozaic 3+硬碟平台已通過主要超大規模資料中心業者的認證並進入量產，該公司也擁有「正在擴大規模的兩年技術領先優勢」。
他補充，希捷科技的Mozaic 4+平台目前也正與全球兩大雲端服務供應商推進量產；至於後續的Mozaic 5+平台，預計明年稍晚開始出貨，並接受客戶認證。
至於威騰電子，Daryanani認為，推論型AI與代理式AI（agentic AI）帶動資料產生速度加快，將進一步推升公司的股價。此外，他也看好威騰電子在投入研發後，將自由現金流全數回饋股東的計畫。
截至目前，威騰電子今年股價已上漲約170%，希捷漲幅則達207%。
在資料中心網路供應商方面，Daryanani點名安費諾(APH-US) 、Arista網路(ANET-US) 與思科系統(CSCO-US) 。
他認為，AI需求持續成長，加上安費諾具備擴大併購規模及拓展終端市場的能力，使其今年及未來都有機會跑贏大盤。
Daryanani指出，安費諾在AI相關銅與光纖連接器領域均具領先地位，因此當客戶在銅與光纖元件之間做選擇時，公司有望成為首選的連接方案供應商。
除了AI之外，安費諾也布局國防與工業市場，旗下產品涵蓋互連系統與天線解決方案，因此Daryanani認為，公司仍存在AI以外的成長機會。
至於Arista網路，Daryanani認為，雲端客戶基礎持續多元化將有助公司成長，未來3至4年更可能出現「超額成長」。企業園區網路架構逐步導入，也將成為另一項成長動能。
他指出，網路市場的總潛在市場規模將持續顯著擴大，而Arista正進一步切入「垂直擴展網路」（scale-up networking）市場，隨著這類網路架構的重要性日益提升，公司有望從中受益。
思科則有望在2027會計年度迎來新的成長機會。Daryanani指出，網路設備更新週期可能為公司帶來「第二階段成長」，進一步補強思科目前已獲既有訂單支持、規模達75億美元的AI營收指引。
此外，Daryanani表示，受惠於其從晶片一路延伸至系統設計的完整架構，思科的Silicon One可程式化網路架構也有望在與博通(AVGO-US) 解決方案的競爭中取得可觀市場機會
Daryanani及其團隊同樣看好蘋果(AAPL-US) 的產品與功能發展路線。
他表示，iPhone產品週期仍具吸引力，累積需求、iPhone 18 Pro產品週期，以及預期中的摺疊iPhone推出，都有望支撐iPhone需求與平均售價，尤其是在基礎款iPhone 18延後推出的情況下。
儘管部分投資人對Apple Intelligence及AI版Siri仍抱持懷疑，但Daryanani認為，如果蘋果能成功推出這些功能，可能延長iPhone產品週期、推動換機需求，並開啟新的營收變現機會。
他更將iPhone形容為消費者AI的「收費站」，認為iPhone是使用者與AI互動的主要裝置。隨著AI工具需求持續增加，蘋果未來可能找到更多方式從這項趨勢中獲取營收。
此外，Daryanani指出，蘋果服務業務過去12季持續維持雙位數成長，即使App Store目前面臨壓力，服務業務的成長仍有望成為公司毛利率的正面因素。
在資本回饋方面，他也認為蘋果將約90%的自由現金流透過股利與股票回購回饋股東，並持續將股東利益置於優先地位，同樣是公司的正面因素。
paras_en: AI hardware spending remains robust, driving a sharp rise in some tech stocks this year. Evercore ISI analyst Amit Daryanani believes that several of the brightest‑performing tech stocks this year still have upside after the second half of 2026.

According to MarketWatch, Daryanani recently released a list of the “six most worth‑holding stocks” for the second half of the year, which includes storage‑equipment and data‑center networking suppliers. He notes that strong AI hardware spending has made these companies key beneficiaries in this year’s tech‑stock market.
In the storage‑equipment space, driven by continued strong demand for hard‑disk drives (HDDs), Daryanani and his team are bullish on Seagate Technology (STX-US) and Western Digital (WDC-US).
Daryanani points out that, with storage product supply staying tight, Seagate’s pricing power is likely to improve further.

Moreover, Seagate’s Mozaic 3+ HDD platform has passed certification by major hyperscale data‑center operators and entered volume production, giving the company a two‑year technology‑lead advantage that is currently being scaled up.

He adds that Seagate’s Mozaic 4+ platform is now being pushed toward volume production with the world’s two largest cloud service providers, and the subsequent Mozaic 5+ platform is expected to ship later next year after customer qualification.

Regarding Western Digital, Daryanani argues that generative AI and agentic AI are accelerating data generation, which should lift the stock further. He also likes the company’s plan to return all free cash flow to shareholders after its R&D investments.
To date, Western Digital’s share price has risen about 170% this year, while Seagate is up roughly 207%.
In the data‑center networking arena, Daryanani calls out Amphenol (APH-US), Arista Networks (ANET-US) and Cisco Systems (CSCO-US).

He believes that continued AI demand, combined with Amphenol’s ability to expand acquisitions and grow its end‑market footprint, gives it the chance to outperform the broader market both this year and going forward.
Daryanani notes that Amphenol leads in AI‑related copper and fiber‑optic connectors, so when customers choose between copper and fiber components, the company is likely to be the preferred supplier.
Beyond AI, Amphenol is also positioning itself in defense and industrial markets, offering interconnect systems and antenna solutions, which Daryanani sees as additional growth avenues outside of AI.

As for Arista Networks, Daryanani sees diversified cloud‑customer bases driving growth, with the potential for “excess returns” over the next three to four years. The rollout of networking in corporate campuses will also add a growth catalyst.

He adds that the total addressable market for networking will keep expanding significantly, and Arista is moving deeper into the “scale‑up networking” segment, positioning it to benefit as these architectures become more critical.

Cisco is expected to encounter a new growth window in fiscal 2027. Daryanani says the network‑equipment refresh cycle could provide a “second‑stage growth” that bolsters Cisco’s AI revenue guidance of $7.5 billion, already supported by existing orders.

Furthermore, Daryanani says Cisco’s Silicon One programmable networking architecture, which spans from chips to system design, could capture sizable market share in competition with Broadcom (AVGO-US) solutions.
Daryanani and his team are also bullish on Apple (AAPL-US) and its product‑development roadmap.

He notes that the iPhone product cycle remains attractive, with cumulative demand, the iPhone 18 Pro cycle, and the anticipated launch of a foldable iPhone expected to support iPhone demand and average selling price, especially as the baseline iPhone 18 rollout is delayed.

Although some investors remain skeptical about Apple Intelligence and an AI‑enabled Siri, Daryanani believes that successful rollout of these features could extend the iPhone cycle, spur upgrade demand, and open new revenue‑monetization opportunities.
He even describes the iPhone as a “toll booth” for consumer AI, viewing it as the primary device for user‑AI interaction. As AI‑tool demand grows, Apple may find more ways to monetize the trend.

Additionally, Daryanani points out that Apple’s services business has posted double‑digit growth for the past twelve quarters; even though the App Store faces pressure, services growth should remain a positive contributor to gross margins.

In terms of capital return, he says Apple plans to return roughly 90% of free cash flow to shareholders via dividends and share buybacks, keeping shareholder interests a top priority, which is another positive factor for the company.

items.title: 美國期中選舉對股市是利多？歷史揭示：今年比以往強、標普500選後12個月從未下跌
items.title_en: Is the U.S. Midterm Election Bullish for Stocks? History Shows This Year Is Stronger Than Usual, and the S&P 500 Has Never Declined in the 12 Months After a Midterm
paras: 儘管美股近期出現回落，市場波動也明顯升高，但若放在歷史脈絡下觀察，今年股市表現仍遠優於典型的美國期中選舉年。
根據《MarketWatch》報導，即使經歷8月20日的市場重挫後，標普500指數今年以來以單純股價計算仍上漲11.6%；相比之下，1954年至2022年間平均期中選舉年在相同時間點則下跌1.3%。
分析指出，在典型的期中選舉年，股市通常要到選舉日前夕才會觸底；之後，市場便會在接下來大部分的12個月內持續穩步上升。
換句話說，即使目前股市再下跌11%，其表現仍不會比典型期中選舉年同期更差。
研究人士指出，股市通常在期中選舉前表現疲弱，原因在於市場會對選舉後可能出現的政府政策感到不確定。在這種不確定性下，股市往往下跌；而一旦不確定性消除，市場便會反彈。
值得注意的是，歷史資料顯示，期中選舉究竟由哪個政黨取得優勢，似乎並不是決定股市選後走勢的關鍵。只要選前的不確定性解除，股市往往都會出現上漲。
然而，今年並未出現這種選前疲弱的走勢。事實上，今年股市表現遠強於歷史典型走勢，以至於一些投資人開始擔心，今年的強勁表現是否代表提前「借用」了明年的部分或全部漲幅。如果真是如此，那麼2027年可能會像今年強勁一樣，呈現相對疲弱的表現。
好消息是，數據並不支持投資人的這項擔憂。沒有具統計顯著性的證據顯示，期中選舉後的股市強勢表現取決於期中選舉前是否先出現疲弱。
事實上，數據反而略微支持相反的情況，如果市場在期中選舉前同樣表現強勁，選舉後的漲勢可能更加強勁。
1998年就是一個例子。當年是最近一次在8月中旬前，標普500年初至今漲幅與今年相近的期中選舉年。在當年期中選舉日之後的12個月內，標普500上漲22%。
當然，期中選舉後股市並非每次都會出現如此強勁的漲幅。但自1954年標普500成立以來，該指數在期中選舉後12個月從未出現下跌。
相較之下，在總統任期週期中另外3年的相同12個月期間，標普500約有28%的時間出現下跌。
paras_en: Despite a recent pullback in U.S. equities and noticeably higher market volatility, the year’s market performance still far outshines a typical U.S. midterm election year when viewed in historical context.

According to MarketWatch, even after the sharp market drop on August 20, the S&P 500 has risen 11.6% year‑to‑date on price alone; by contrast, the average midterm election year from 1954 to 2022 fell 1.3% at the same point in the cycle.
Analysis notes that in a typical midterm year the market usually bottoms only on the eve of the election, then climbs steadily for most of the following 12 months.
In other words, even if the market were to fall another 11% now, its performance would still not be worse than the same period in a typical midterm year.

Researchers point out that markets tend to be weak before midterms because investors are uncertain about post‑election government policy; that uncertainty often drags stocks down, and once it clears the market rebounds.
Historical data show that which party wins the midterms does not appear to be the key driver of post‑election market direction—once pre‑election uncertainty is resolved, stocks generally rise.

However, this year has not shown the usual pre‑election weakness. In fact, the market’s strength has been so far above the historical norm that some investors worry the rally may have “borrowed” part or all of next year’s gains, potentially leaving 2027 weaker if that’s the case.
The good news is the data do not support that concern. There is no statistically significant evidence that a strong post‑midterm rally depends on pre‑election weakness.
On the contrary, the data slightly favor the opposite: if the market is already strong before the midterms, the post‑election rally may be even stronger.

1998 provides an example. It was the most recent midterm year before mid‑August when the year‑to‑date S&P 500 gain was similar to this year’s, and the index rose 22% in the 12 months after the election that year.

Of course, the market does not always post such a vigorous gain after a midterm, but since the S&P 500’s inception in 1954, it has never posted a decline in the 12 months following a midterm election.
By contrast, in the same 12‑month window during the other three years of a presidential term, the S&P 500 has fallen about 28% of the time.

items.title: 本週操盤筆記：輝達財報、華許演說與PCE三大關卡來了
items.title_en: This Week's Trading Notes: Nvidia Earnings, Warsh Speech, and PCE – Three Major Tests Ahead
paras: 美股經歷債市、加密貨幣與個股行情劇烈反轉的一週後，本週將迎來三大關鍵考驗，包括輝達(NVDA-US)財報、聯準會(Fed)主席華許(Kevin Warsh)首度以主席身分出席傑克森霍爾全球央行年會，以及會前公布的美國通膨與經濟成長數據。這些事件將共同檢驗今年美股上漲的兩項核心假設：人工智慧(AI)需求能否延續，以及利率環境是否仍足以支撐高估值資產。
全球公債殖利率上週大幅攀升，30年期美債殖利率一度觸及2007年以來最高水準，推高家庭與企業借貸成本，也為投入巨額資金興建AI基礎設施的科技公司增加融資壓力。
美國財政部宣布將長天期債券回購規模提高一倍，一度帶動殖利率回落，但行情隔日便大幅逆轉。標普500指數上週走低，距離歷史高點約2%；費城半導體指數週線更下跌約5%，反映殖利率上升已對高估值晶片股造成壓力。
市場波動也延伸至個股與加密貨幣。莫德納(MRNA-US)因癌症疫苗取得重大進展，上週三成為標普500指數表現最佳成分股，隔日卻跌至指數末段班。另一方面，比特幣上週大漲近25%，上週五早盤逼近7.8萬美元，顯示短線資金重新湧向加密貨幣。
若今年推動AI行情的熱錢開始轉向比特幣等其他風險資產，可能削弱科技股多頭動能。因此，本週一連串重要事件將左右資金是否重新回流AI概念股，或持續轉往其他市場。

輝達財報檢驗AI需求成色

輝達預計8月26日公布第二季財報。由於其晶片支撐全球大部分AI基礎設施建設，輝達已不只是一家半導體公司，更被市場視為整個AI生態系統的代表，其業績可反映晶片、資料中心及相關融資需求是否依然強勁。
Arena Private Wealth投資長Erik Kratz表示，當前市場高度依賴AI交易，而輝達無疑是其中最具影響力的企業，財報結果將牽動整個科技產業。從晶片供應商到替資料中心擴建提供資金的金融機構，都可能受到輝達需求展望影響。
輝達近期與六家大型金融機構合作，籌組規模超過5,000億美元的AI基礎設施融資平台，凸顯企業與各國政府競相興建AI資料中心所需的龐大資本。
本週AI與半導體股罕見退居市場焦點之外，輝達財報將讓投資人重新評估AI需求是否足以支撐相關企業的高額投資與估值。市場尤其需要輝達證明AI熱潮依然強勁，而不是在債券殖利率與融資成本升高之際出現急轉彎。
若輝達業績與財測優於預期，可能重新凝聚科技股多頭信心；反之，任何需求放緩、成本上升或資本支出疑慮，都可能使本週已承壓的晶片股面臨新一波賣壓。

華許首次以Fed主席身分赴傑克森霍爾

傑克森霍爾全球央行年會將於8月27日至29日舉行，這也是華許今年5月就任Fed主席後，首度以主席身分出席這項重要央行盛會。市場將密切關注他如何說明貨幣政策框架，以及在不再提供傳統前瞻指引的情況下，如何與投資人溝通。
華許在7月利率會議後並未清楚說明，如果通膨持續居高不下，Fed將採取何種行動，一度引發市場震盪。Aptus Capital Advisors股票主管David Wagner指出，目前政策前景仍缺乏明確性，近期美債劇烈波動正反映投資人的困惑，因此市場目光都將集中在傑克森霍爾。
TritonPoint Wealth投資長Will Sterling預期，華許可能重申以經濟數據為依據的政策框架，要求投資人自行觀察數據並判斷利率走向。這種作法可能增加短期波動，但也能避免市場把Fed的訊號誤解為政策承諾。
Wagner認為，減少前瞻指引長期而言未必是壞事，因為可迫使投資人自行重新評估利率前景。儘管外界擔心華許可能損害Fed聲譽，但上次會議有三名官員對利率決策提出不同意見，也反映Fed內部仍能獨立表達立場。
目前利率市場反映，Fed在9月升息的機率約為35%，到12月前升息的機率則升至66%。華許對通膨、長期殖利率與Fed資產負債表的說法，都可能重新調整市場對升息路徑的預期。

通膨與經濟成長數據提供政策線索

在傑克森霍爾年會前，美國將公布7月個人消費支出物價指數(PCE)及經濟成長報告。PCE是Fed偏好的通膨指標，兩項數據將提供最新的物價與經濟動能圖像，也可能直接影響華許演說的內容及市場反應。
如果通膨依然頑固、經濟成長保持強勁，市場可能進一步提高Fed升息預期，推升美債殖利率並壓迫科技股估值。對AI產業而言，利率上升不僅影響股價，也會增加資料中心、能源設施及晶片投資的融資成本。
相反地，若通膨明顯降溫或經濟成長轉弱，投資人可能降低升息押注，但也會重新擔憂AI需求與企業獲利能否維持。市場因此面臨兩難：數據太強可能推高利率，數據太弱又可能打擊成長預期。
在財政部擴大回購仍無法持續壓低殖利率、短線資金快速流向比特幣之際，下周三大事件可能決定美股多頭能否延續。輝達必須證明AI投資仍有基本面支撐，華許則須讓市場理解Fed的政策框架；PCE與經濟成長數據，則將檢驗兩者面對的是強韌經濟，還是通膨與高利率交織的新風險。
paras_en: After a week of sharp reversals in bonds, crypto and individual stocks, U.S. equities face three key tests this week: Nvidia (NVDA-US) earnings, Fed Chair Kevin Warsh’s first appearance at the Jackson Hole Global Central Bank Meeting as chair, and pre‑meeting U.S. inflation and growth data. Together they will test the two core assumptions behind this year’s rally – whether AI demand can endure and whether the rate environment can still support lofty valuations.

Global sovereign‑bond yields surged last week, with the 30‑year U.S. Treasury briefly hitting its highest level since 2007, raising borrowing costs for households and firms and adding financing pressure to tech companies pouring massive capital into AI infrastructure.

The U.S. Treasury announced a doubling of its long‑term bond buy‑back size, briefly pulling yields lower before the market reversed sharply the next day. The S&P 500 slipped last week, about 2% off its all‑time high, while the Philadelphia Semiconductor Index fell roughly 5% on the weekly chart, reflecting pressure on high‑multiple chip stocks from rising yields.

Volatility spread to stocks and crypto. Moderna (MRNA‑US) surged to become the top‑performing S&P 500 component after a major cancer‑vaccine breakthrough, then fell to the bottom of the index the next day. Meanwhile Bitcoin rallied nearly 25% last week, briefly approaching $78,000 on Friday morning, showing short‑term capital flowing back into crypto.

If the hot money that has been driving the AI rally starts shifting to Bitcoin and other risk assets, it could sap momentum from tech‑stock bulls. Hence this week’s string of events will decide whether capital returns to AI‑themed equities or continues drifting into other markets.
This week’s trading notes (Aug 24‑28).

Nvidia earnings test AI demand strength. Nvidia is slated to release its Q2 results on Aug 26. Because its chips underpin most global AI infrastructure, Nvidia is seen not just as a semiconductor firm but as a proxy for the entire AI ecosystem, and its performance will signal whether chip, data‑center and related financing demand remain robust.

Erik Kratz, CIO of Arena Private Wealth, said the market is heavily AI‑driven and Nvidia is undoubtedly the most influential player; its earnings will move the whole tech sector. From chip makers to the financial institutions funding data‑center expansion, all could feel the impact of Nvidia’s demand outlook.

Nvidia has recently teamed with six major banks to launch an AI‑infrastructure financing platform exceeding $500 billion, underscoring the massive capital needed as corporations and governments race to build AI data centers.

With AI and semiconductor stocks unusually out of the spotlight this week, Nvidia’s results will force investors to reassess whether AI demand can justify the lofty investments and valuations of related firms. The market especially wants Nvidia to prove the AI boom is still strong, not about to reverse amid higher bond yields and financing costs.

If Nvidia beats expectations, it could rekindle bullish confidence in tech stocks; conversely, any sign of slowing demand, rising costs or cap‑ex doubts could trigger a fresh wave of selling pressure on already‑stressed chip shares.

Warsh’s first appearance as Fed chair at Jackson Hole. The Jackson Hole Global Central Bank Meeting runs Aug 27‑29, marking Warsh’s first attendance as chair since taking the helm in May. Markets will watch how he frames monetary policy and communicates with investors without the traditional forward guidance.

Warsh left the July rate‑policy meeting vague on what the Fed would do if inflation stayed high, sparking market turbulence. David Wagner, head of equities at Aptus Capital Advisors, noted that policy outlook remains unclear and recent Treasury volatility reflects investor confusion, so all eyes will be on Jackson Hole.

Will Sterling, CIO of TritonPoint Wealth, expects Warsh may reiterate a data‑dependent policy framework, urging investors to watch the numbers and form their own rate expectations. This could boost short‑term volatility but avoid misreading Fed signals as firm commitments.

Wagner argues that reducing forward guidance isn’t necessarily bad long‑term, as it forces investors to re‑evaluate rate expectations themselves. Although some worry Warsh could damage the Fed’s credibility, the last meeting saw three officials voice differing views on rate decisions, showing internal independence.

Current rate‑market pricing puts the odds of a September Fed hike at about 35% and the chance of a hike before December at roughly 66%. Warsh’s comments on inflation, long‑term yields and the Fed’s balance sheet could reshape market expectations for the rate‑path.

Inflation and growth data provide policy clues. Ahead of Jackson Hole, the U.S. will release July’s personal consumption expenditures (PCE) price index and growth report. PCE is the Fed’s preferred inflation gauge; both numbers will paint the latest price‑and‑growth picture and could directly shape Warsh’s remarks and market reaction.

If inflation remains stubborn and growth stays strong, markets may push Fed‑hike expectations higher, lifting Treasury yields and squeezing tech‑stock valuations. For AI firms, higher rates not only depress stock prices but also raise financing costs for data centers, energy facilities and chip investments.

Conversely, if inflation cools markedly or growth weakens, investors may dial back rate‑hike bets, yet concerns will arise about whether AI demand and corporate earnings can be sustained. The market faces a dilemma: overly strong data could spur rates, while weak data could dent growth expectations.

With the Treasury’s expanded buy‑back unable to keep yields down and short‑term capital sprinting into Bitcoin, next week’s three events will likely decide whether the U.S. equity bull market can persist. Nvidia must prove AI investment still has fundamentals, Warsh must help the market grasp the Fed’s policy framework, and the PCE and growth numbers will test whether the backdrop is a resilient economy or a new risk mix of inflation and high rates.

items.title: 美債危機進入倒數？達里歐警告恐在3年內爆發
items.title_en: Ray Dalio Warns U.S. Debt Crisis May Explode Within Three Years
paras: 橋水基金創辦人達里歐（Ray Dalio）再度示警，美國債務問題正朝危機逼近，若現況未改變，債務危機可能在未來三年內爆發、上下浮動約兩年。他建議投資人降低債券等債務類資產配置，提高黃金比重，並持有少量比特幣。
全球長期公債近期遭遇拋售，美國長債殖利率持續攀升，達利歐日前在專欄文章指出，近期日本拋售美債支撐日元、美國長期公債殖利率走高，以及美國財長貝森特近期的相關表態，都與他在《國家為什麼會破產：橋水基金應對大週期的原則》中描述的經典模式相符。
他認為，持續攀升的債務償付成本，最終將與投資人需求不足發生衝突，迫使政府接受更高利率，或由央行透過印鈔購買國債，後者將進一步削弱貨幣價值並推升通膨。
以美國為例，達里歐估算，美國政府今年總收入約5.5兆美元，總支出約7.5兆美元，預算缺口約2兆美元；目前債務餘額則約32兆美元，不計政府間債務，相當於政府年收入的近6倍，每年利息支出更超過1兆美元。
若把美國政府視為一家企業，光是支付利息就占年收入約20%，同時還有約10兆美元債券本金需要償還。
換言之，美國政府需要從市場籌措約11兆美元，才能避免主權債務違約，融資規模相當於年收入的兩倍。
達里歐因此預測，若美國未設法扭轉目前局面，債務危機「可能在三年內爆發，上下浮動兩年左右」。而且面臨債務壓力的不只美國，他認為，在各經濟體經歷債務與貨幣貶值調整期間，黃金與比特幣等資產的相對表現可能較佳。
在資產配置方面，達里歐主張充分分散投資，選擇收入狀況與資產負債表穩健，且國內政治及外部地緣衝突較低的國家與資產類別。他建議低配債券等債務類資產、超配黃金，同時配置少量比特幣。
其中，他認為個人資金可有一小部分、例如10%至15%配置黃金，不僅有助降低整體投資組合風險，也可能提高整體報酬率。
巧合的是，黃金與比特幣上周五(21日)同步走強，現貨黃金一度漲逾2%，睽違3個月重返每盎司4,600美元上方；比特幣則一度逼近8萬美元。
事實上，達里歐對美國債務問題的警告已持續多年，近年更頻繁強調美國正處於大債務週期末期。針對如何延後甚至化解危機，他認為美國必須「三管齊下」，透過削減支出、增加稅收及降低利率，將目前約占GDP 6%的預算赤字壓低至3%。
paras_en: Ray Dalio, founder of Bridgewater Associates, again warns that the U.S. debt problem is approaching a crisis. If the current situation does not change, a debt crisis could erupt within the next three years, fluctuating for about two years. He advises investors to reduce allocations to bonds and other debt assets, increase gold holdings, and hold a small amount of Bitcoin.

Global long‑term government bonds have recently been sold off, and U.S. long‑term bond yields have continued to rise. In a recent column, Dalio noted that Japan’s recent sale of U.S. Treasuries, the rise in U.S. long‑term yields, and Treasury Secretary Janet Yellen’s recent statements all match the classic pattern he describes in "Why Nations Fail: Principles for Responding to the Great Cycle."

He believes that the continuously rising debt‑service costs will eventually clash with insufficient investor demand, forcing the government to accept higher rates or for the central bank to print money to buy bonds. The latter would further erode monetary value and drive inflation.

Taking the United States as an example, Dalio estimates that the U.S. government’s total revenue this year is about $5.5 trillion, total spending about $7.5 trillion, and a budget deficit of roughly $2 trillion. The current debt balance is about $32 trillion, excluding intergovernmental debt, which is nearly six times the government’s annual revenue, and annual interest payments exceed $1 trillion.
If the U.S. government is viewed as a corporation, paying interest alone consumes about 20% of annual revenue, and there is also about $10 trillion in bond principal that must be repaid.
In other words, the U.S. government would need to raise about $11 trillion from the market to avoid a sovereign debt default, a financing scale equivalent to twice its annual revenue.

Dalio therefore predicts that if the U.S. fails to reverse the current situation, the debt crisis "could erupt within three years, fluctuating for about two years." He also notes that the debt pressure is not limited to the U.S.; during periods of debt and currency devaluation adjustments in various economies, assets such as gold and Bitcoin may perform relatively better.

In terms of asset allocation, Dalio advocates full diversification, choosing countries and asset classes with stable income, robust balance sheets, and low domestic political and external geopolitical conflict. He recommends a low allocation to bonds and other debt assets, an overweight allocation to gold, and a small allocation to Bitcoin.
Specifically, he believes that individuals can allocate a small portion, such as 10% to 15%, to gold, which not only helps reduce overall portfolio risk but may also increase overall returns.

Coincidentally, gold and Bitcoin both strengthened on Friday, the 21st, with spot gold rising more than 2% at one point, returning above $4,600 per ounce for the first time in three months, while Bitcoin approached $80,000 at one point.

In fact, Dalio’s warning about U.S. debt has persisted for years, and in recent years he has increasingly emphasized that the U.S. is in the late stage of a major debt cycle. To delay or even resolve the crisis, he believes the U.S. must "take three measures together": cut spending, raise taxes, and lower interest rates to reduce the current budget deficit, which is about 6% of GDP, to 3%.

items.title: 避險基金加碼做空美元   貝森特擴大長債回購引發信心危機
items.title_en: Hedge Funds Ramp Up Short Positions on the Dollar as Bentsen Expands Long‑Term Treasury Repurchase, Triggering Confidence Crisis
paras: 市場靜待美國財長貝森特公佈新財政計畫細節應對借貸成本居數十年高點之際，避險基金正大舉加碼美元空頭押注。
上周三(19日)，貝森特宣佈將10至30年期美債回購規模「至少翻倍」，美元應聲創下近三週最大單日跌幅紀錄，現貨市場湧現拋售潮，今(24)日在亞洲匯市早盤則變化不大。
巴克莱銀行G10貨幣交易聯席主管Torsten Schöneborn指出，避險基金在線性外匯交易上反應尤為劇烈，延續8月以來的美元賣壓。
投資人擔憂，美國財政部以激進手段壓長端利率，等於用行政力量扭曲定價，最終將侵蝕市場對美元的信心。
與此同時，選擇權市場也釋出悲觀信號：防範美元未來一個月下跌的溢價已攀升至2月以來最高。
花旗亞太區外匯選擇權主管 Akshay Saxena表示，自長債回購計畫公佈後，對沖美元下行風險的需求明顯擴散，貝森特的「殖利率管理」正把財政部推向聯準會(Fed)的角色，而代價可能是美元儲備貨幣的光環進一步褪色。
paras_en: The market is awaiting Treasury Secretary Janet Bentsen’s announcement of new fiscal plans to address borrowing costs at multi‑decade highs, while hedge funds are dramatically increasing short bets on the dollar.

On Wednesday (19th), Bentsen announced that the Treasury’s 10‑ to 30‑year Treasury repurchase program would be "at least doubled," prompting the dollar to record its largest single‑day decline in nearly three weeks; the spot market saw a wave of sell‑offs, and the Asian currency market remained largely unchanged on Thursday (24th).

Torsten Schöneborn, co‑head of G10 currency trading at Barclays, noted that hedge funds are reacting especially sharply in linear FX trading, continuing the dollar selling pressure that has persisted since August.
Investors worry that the Treasury’s aggressive tactics to suppress long‑term rates amount to using executive power to distort pricing, ultimately eroding confidence in the dollar.
At the same time, the options market is sending a bearish signal: the premium to hedge against a dollar decline over the next month has risen to its highest level since February.

Akshay Saxena, head of FX options for Citi Asia Pacific, said that since the long‑term repurchase plan was announced, demand to hedge against dollar downside has clearly expanded; Bentsen’s "yield‑management" is pushing the Treasury toward a Fed‑like role, and the cost may be further erosion of the dollar’s reserve‑currency halo.

items.title: 美債突破40兆美元「不會崩盤」？大摩示警：真正風險在股債資金轉向
paras: 摩根士丹利(MS-US)認為，40兆美元美債本身並不代表美國經濟即將陷入危機，真正需要關注的，是高債務環境是否最終改變投資人的股債配置，以及企業獲利成長能否持續支撐目前的資產估值。
美國聯邦債務規模突破40兆美元，市場對財政壓力與經濟前景的擔憂升溫。不過，摩根士丹利 全球固定收益研究主管Andrew Sheets認為，高額政府債務確實可能限制經濟活動，但目前還不足以引發系統性崩潰，企業與家庭資產負債表持續改善，將成為重要緩衝。
Sheets在最新報告指出，美國聯邦債務過去10年增加20兆美元，僅最近3個月就增加超過1兆美元。與此同時，全球主要經濟體的政府債務占GDP比重普遍攀升。
值得注意的是，政府部門槓桿上升的同時，美國企業與家庭部門的財務狀況並未同步惡化。
Sheets認為，這項結構性差異代表政府債務對實體經濟造成的衝擊，可能低於市場目前的擔憂。

企業發債創新高　但槓桿率未明顯惡化

摩根士丹利指出，受到科技支出增加及併購活動回溫帶動，美國企業債券發行規模持續創新高，信用策略團隊預期，今年全年發行量可能再次刷新紀錄。
但Sheets認為，企業大舉發債本身並不代表系統性風險正在累積。過去10年，美國企業債務占GDP比率大致持平，且低於疫情前水準。
其中，超大規模科技企業（hyperscaler）的槓桿率仍相對偏低，加上AI投資帶來的報酬率，使企業承擔較高融資成本仍具有一定合理性。
報告因此預期，即使殖利率持續走高，也不至於立即中斷企業融資，信用利差則可能僅溫和擴大。

美國家庭負債降至GDP的67%

家庭部門的財務狀況同樣提供一定支撐。報告顯示，美國家庭債務目前約占GDP的67%，低於2000年的約70%與2019年的74%。
值得注意的是，家庭債務占比下降並不代表家庭完全不受高利率環境影響。Sheets指出，美國許多房貸早已在過去低利率時期完成固定，且房價等家庭資產價值上升，讓家庭整體財務狀況獲得一定支撐，也有助於消費維持韌性。
不過，房市等高度依賴利率的領域已受到明顯壓抑，因此利率變化對家庭支出的影響，可能需要更長時間才會充分反映。
這種「政府加槓桿、私人部門改善資產負債表」的現象也出現在其他主要經濟體。歐洲部分國家政府債務占GDP比重提高之際，企業與家庭反而持續降低負債；日本雖然公共部門借貸增加，私人部門的槓桿程度卻大致維持穩定。
Sheets認為，這與各國過去的政策選擇有關，包括美國、法國、日本、瑞典、瑞士、義大利及英國在過去10年均曾降低稅率，使公共部門財務狀況相對私人部門出現更明顯的惡化。

真正風險可能在股債資金重新配置

相較於企業停止借貸或家庭大幅削減消費，Sheets認為，高額政府債務真正可能對金融市場造成衝擊的關鍵，在於投資人是否開始認為債券相較股票具有更具吸引力的風險報酬。
報告指出，目前美國30年期國債殖利率比預期通膨高出約300個基點，長天期美國投資級公司債殖利率則達6.2%。
然而，目前資金流向及股債價格關係仍未顯示出明顯的資產重新配置跡象。近期股票與債券價格仍呈現同向波動，尚未出現資金大規模從股市轉向債市的明確訊號。
在這種環境下，企業獲利成長成為維持市場穩定的重要因素。年初至今標普500指數上漲約13%，同期美國10年期國債殖利率上升約50個基點，但股票風險溢價大致維持穩定。
Sheets將目前環境與1990年代末期的市場狀況進行比較，並警告，一旦企業獲利成長開始放緩，市場脆弱性可能明顯升高。

摩根士丹利看好英國抗通膨債、澳元

在全球財政狀況分化之際，摩根士丹利也提出部分相對具吸引力的市場。
報告指出，英國是少數預期財政赤字將收窄的主要經濟體之一，因此該行看好英國通膨掛鉤債券。
此外，澳洲政府債務占GDP比率僅約49%，加上相對較高的利差收益，使澳元也受到青睞。
相較之下，Sheets對美元前景持較謹慎態度。他認為，如果美國財政部進一步介入長天期利率，可能對美元形成壓力，同時美國國債殖利率曲線7年至30年期區段可能重新趨於陡峭。

items.title: 三星拋出HBM三階段路線圖：從「騰空間」到3D zHBM消滅中介層   終極架構將降功耗70%、頻寬飆230%
items.title_en: Samsung Unveils Three‑Stage HBM Roadmap: From "Space Reclamation" to 3D zHBM Eliminating the Interposer, Ultimate Architecture Cuts Power 70% and Boosts Bandwidth 230%
paras: 在近日舉行的 Hot Chips 技術大會上，三星DRAM設計團隊的Sangwook Han正式揭露三星HBM演進的三階段路線圖，終點是一種名為zHBM​的全新架構，也就是將DRAM直接垂直堆疊在GPU、TPU等運算晶片之上，徹底取消2.5D中介層。
美國科技媒體《wccftech》周日(23日)報導，相較於標準 HBM4E，zHBM宣稱可實現70%功耗降低、230% DRAM頻寬提升，每個DRAM模組節省100W功耗，同時為GPU釋出8.3%額外功率空間。

HBM由兩類晶片構成：一是C-die(核心晶片)，包含DRAM儲存單位，可垂直堆疊最多16層；二是 B-die(基礎晶片)，位於整個堆疊底部，負責處理各類DRAM控制功能，並透過 PHY(實體介面層)與GPU等運算晶片通訊，兩者之間透過TSV(矽穿孔)​連接，這是一種穿透晶片的垂直導電通道。目前HBM4每個堆疊頻寬已超過3TB/s，HBM4E推進至4TB/s 區間，HBM5則在 HBM4基礎上頻寬翻倍、容量超過60GB。
但頻寬持續擴展正面臨兩大約束：TSV數量與間距的物理極限，以及基礎晶片內PHY介面I/O數量與速度上限。與此同時，基礎晶片與運算晶片(xPU SoC)之間的製程代差正逐代縮小，這既是挑戰，也為三星的路線圖提供了切入點。

路線圖第一階段的核心目標，是從xPU「搶回」矽面積。三星已將D1c與4奈米邏輯製程應用於HBM4的Base Die，主要目的是降低功耗、縮減有效面積，這是DRAM與先進邏輯製程真正融合的起點。具體措施包括：用D2D介面替換傳統HBM PHY，縮短通道長度，直接改善能效，同時為xPU釋出寶貴矽片面積；將記憶體控制器從xPU卸載至cHBM的基礎晶片(B-die)，預計可為xPU釋出5%-10%面積，對應10%-20%效能提升；引入基於SRAM的細粒度修復方案，利用B-die上的閒置空間部署修復資源。
面積縮減帶來的副作用是熱點問題，三星推出Heat Path Block(HPB)技術，建構於cHBM4方案之上，可將峰值溫度降低逾 35%，覆蓋 50% 的 PHY 區域。

第二階段路線則從「騰空間」轉向「加功能」，三星定義為功能擴展階段。首先擴展記憶體容量：隨著AI大模型上下文視窗急劇擴大，KV快取(模型推理時用於儲存中間狀態的記憶體區域)需求呈指數級增長，三星擬在Base Die閒置矽面積上整合記憶體擴展控制器與PHY，透過外接LPDDR或HBM等方案擴充系統可用記憶體容量。其次整合處理單元(PE)，在Base Die上整合部分計算處理單位，將部分原本需要在xPU上完成的計算卸載至記憶體側，降低D2D頻寬需求、減少功耗與熱負擔，此形態稱為AHBM(Advanced HBM)。
此外，還包括強化可靠性與測試能力：在Base Die上整合先進RAS(可靠性、可用性、可維護性)感測器與即時遙測功能，以及片上自測試(ATIP)能力，提升良率與測試涵蓋率。
第三階段是整個路線圖的終極形態。當前主流AI系統採用2.5D封裝架構，GPU與HBM並排置於同一塊中介層上，透過橫向互連傳輸資料。zHBM的概念是將這一結構「豎起來」——把DRAM堆疊直接壓在xPU晶片之上，形成真正的3D垂直整合。
三星DRAM設計團隊描述的關鍵特性包括：分散式 I/O(最小化 HBM 堆疊內資料傳輸距離)、3D結構(消除傳統 2D 介面，大幅提升系統效率)、I/O功耗目標約0.5 pJ/bit(透過移除 SerDes 等冗餘模組實現)、頻寬提升超2.3倍、系統熱餘量達100W。三星演示的方案為四堆疊，zHBM疊加在一顆xPU 之上。
為實現上述目標，三星正在研發兩項關鍵封裝技術：WoW(Wafer on Wafer) HCB(Hybrid Cube Bonding)，以實現超高 I/O 密度，並最終建構統一的 SoC-DRAM 協同設計體系。
路線圖背後的核心邏輯是，將HBM的Base Die從「被動的資料中轉站」重新定位為「具備主動運算能力的智慧夥伴」。三個階段的演進邏輯清晰，先透過製程升級壓縮面積、釋放 xPU 空間(第一階段)；再利用釋出的空間整合更多功能、擴展容量與運算能力(第二階段)；最終透過3D垂直整合徹底重構系統架構，在功耗、頻寬與熱管理三方面同步突破(第三階段)。
三星的Sangwook Han在演說中總結道：「透過掌握先進封裝與統一SoC-DRAM協同設計，我們將突破制約AI系統的功耗、面積與容量瓶頸，為未來數年更高效率、更高效能、更強可擴展性鋪平道路。」
paras_en: At the recent Hot Chips conference, Samsung DRAM design team member Sangwook Han officially disclosed Samsung's three‑stage roadmap for HBM evolution, culminating in a brand‑new architecture called zHBM that stacks DRAM directly on compute chips such as GPUs and TPUs, completely removing the 2.5D interposer layer.

According to U.S. tech outlet wccftech on Sunday the 23rd, zHBM claims a 70% power reduction and a 230% DRAM bandwidth increase compared with standard HBM4E, saving 100 W per DRAM module and freeing an additional 8.3% power headroom for GPUs.

HBM consists of two types of chips: the C‑die (core die) that contains the DRAM storage cells and can be vertically stacked up to 16 layers, and the B‑die (base die) at the bottom of the stack that handles various DRAM control functions and communicates with GPUs or other compute chips via a PHY (physical interface layer). The two are linked by TSVs (silicon‑through‑holes), vertical conductive channels that pass through the chips. Current HBM4 stacks already exceed 3 TB/s bandwidth, HBM4E pushes that to the 4 TB/s range, and HBM5 doubles the bandwidth of HBM4 while offering more than 60 GB capacity.

However, continued bandwidth growth faces two major constraints: the physical limits of TSV count and spacing, and the I/O count and speed ceiling of the PHY interfaces inside the base die. At the same time, the process‑node gap between the base die and the compute chip (xPU SoC) is shrinking each generation, which is both a challenge and an entry point for Samsung's roadmap.

The first stage’s core goal is to reclaim silicon area from the xPU. Samsung has applied its D1c and 4‑nm logic processes to the Base Die of HBM4 to cut power and reduce effective area, marking the true start of DRAM‑advanced‑logic integration. Specific measures include replacing the traditional HBM PHY with a D2D interface to shorten channel length and improve energy efficiency while freeing valuable silicon for the xPU; offloading the memory controller from the xPU to the cHBM base die (B‑die), expected to free 5%‑10% of xPU area and yield 10%‑20% performance gains; and introducing a fine‑grained SRAM‑based repair scheme that uses idle space on the B‑die to host repair resources.

The area reduction creates hotspot issues, so Samsung introduced Heat Path Block (HPB) technology built on the cHBM4 solution, which can lower peak temperature by more than 35% across 50% of the PHY region.

The second stage shifts from "space reclamation" to "function addition," defined by Samsung as the functional expansion phase. First, memory capacity will be expanded: as AI large‑model context windows grow dramatically, demand for KV caches (memory regions storing intermediate states during inference) is rising exponentially. Samsung plans to integrate memory‑expansion controllers and PHY into idle silicon on the Base Die, allowing system memory to be enlarged via external LPDDR or HBM solutions. Second, processing units (PE) will be integrated on the Base Die, offloading some compute that would otherwise run on the xPU to the memory side, reducing D2D bandwidth needs, power consumption, and thermal load; this form is called Advanced HBM (AHBM).

In addition, reliability and test capabilities will be strengthened: advanced RAS (reliability, availability, serviceability) sensors and real‑time telemetry will be integrated on the Base Die, along with on‑chip self‑test (ATIP) features to improve yield and test coverage.

The third stage represents the ultimate form of the roadmap. Today’s mainstream AI systems use a 2.5D packaging architecture with GPUs and HBM placed side‑by‑side on a common interposer, communicating via lateral interconnects. zHBM’s concept is to “stand this up” – stacking DRAM directly on top of the xPU chip to achieve true 3D vertical integration.

Key characteristics described by Samsung’s DRAM design team include distributed I/O (minimizing data travel distance within the HBM stack), a 3D structure (eliminating the traditional 2D interface and dramatically improving system efficiency), an I/O power target of about 0.5 pJ/bit (achieved by removing redundant modules such as SerDes), more than a 2.3× bandwidth boost, and a system thermal headroom of 100 W. Samsung’s demonstration used a four‑stack configuration with zHBM stacked on a single xPU.

To achieve these goals, Samsung is developing two critical packaging technologies: WoW (Wafer‑on‑Wafer) HCB (Hybrid Cube Bonding) to attain ultra‑high I/O density, and ultimately a unified SoC‑DRAM co‑design ecosystem.

The logic behind the roadmap is to reposition the HBM Base Die from a passive data relay to an active, intelligent partner. The three stages follow a clear evolution: first compress area and free xPU space through process upgrades (stage 1); then use the freed space to add functions, expand capacity and compute capability (stage 2); finally, reconstruct the system architecture via 3D vertical integration, delivering simultaneous breakthroughs in power, bandwidth and thermal management (stage 3).

Sangwook Han of Samsung concluded his talk: "By mastering advanced packaging and a unified SoC‑DRAM co‑design approach, we will break the power, area and capacity bottlenecks that constrain AI systems, paving the way for higher efficiency, higher performance and greater scalability in the years ahead."

items.title: 美伊經濟戰全面升級 伊朗撂狠話：荷姆茲海峽恐無石油出口
items.title_en: U.S.-Iran Economic War Escalates, Iran Warns Homs Strait May Shut Oil Exports
paras: 美伊緊張關係再度升溫。美國總統川普宣布對伊朗採取「毀滅性經濟行動」，財政部長貝森特更預告祭出「史無前例的經濟孤立」措施。伊朗隨即強硬回應，警告若美方持續發動經濟戰，荷姆茲海峽乃至波斯灣地區恐將不再有石油出口。
伊朗最高國家安全委員會秘書雷札伊23日表示，如果美國繼續對伊朗發動經濟戰，將不會有石油經由荷姆茲海峽乃至波斯灣地區出口。伊朗也將把任何國家參與或支持美國對伊朗人民發動的經濟戰，視為戰爭行為。
伊朗伊斯蘭革命衛隊發言人穆赫比同日表示，伊朗已針對美國各種敵對行動制定應對方案，包括因應經濟施壓。他指出，美國日前宣稱將對伊朗發動「最嚴厲的經濟戰」，反映美方未能在軍事領域實現目標；美國對伊朗實施經濟制裁已有47年，目前相關說法意在對伊朗民眾施加心理壓力。
穆赫比強調，伊朗已制定方案降低「經濟戰」帶來的不利影響，並將繼續與其他國家進行經濟往來、繞過美國限制。他稱伊朗在經濟領域「沒有擔憂」，相關措施效果將在不久後顯現。
伊朗外交部長阿拉格齊也表示，伊朗從未害怕美國制裁，美方過去無論採取封鎖或軍事行動都以失敗告終，川普提出的新一輪「經濟行動」只是美國政策一貫的霸凌手段。他認為，美方除了與伊朗進行相互尊重的對話，尋求基於公正與榮譽的解決方案外，沒有其他方法。
不過，伊朗總統佩澤希齊揚22日晚間表示，伊朗也應以理性方式，使國家擺脫「既非戰爭，也非和平」的狀態。他指出，伊朗不可能永遠依靠戰爭走下去，在戰爭或「非戰非和」狀態下，也難以吸引投資。
與此同時，美國對伊朗的海上封鎖持續進行。美國中央司令部表示，截至8月23日，美軍已要求70艘商船改變航向，使3艘商船失去行動能力，並登臨檢查2艘商船；「約翰・芬恩號」飛彈驅逐艦目前正在阿拉伯海執行相關任務。
paras_en: The U.S.-Iran tensions have flared again as President Trump announced a "devastating economic action" against Iran, and Treasury Secretary Blinken warned of an unprecedented economic isolation. Iran responded forcefully, warning that if the U.S. continues its economic war, the Homs Strait and even the Persian Gulf region may see no oil exports.

Iran's National Security Council Secretary Rezai said on the 23rd that if the U.S. continues its economic war against Iran, there will be no oil exported through the Homs Strait or the Persian Gulf. Iran will also consider any country that participates in or supports the U.S. economic war against the Iranian people as an act of war.

Iran's Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps spokesperson Mohabb said on the same day that Iran has prepared countermeasures for various U.S. hostile actions, including economic pressure. He noted that the U.S. recently claimed it would launch the "most severe economic war" against Iran, reflecting the U.S.'s failure to achieve its military objectives; the U.S. has imposed economic sanctions on Iran for 47 years, and the current rhetoric aims to psychologically pressure the Iranian people.

Mohabb emphasized that Iran has devised plans to reduce the adverse effects of the "economic war" and will continue economic exchanges with other countries, bypassing U.S. restrictions. He said Iran has no concerns in the economic field, and the effectiveness of these measures will become apparent soon.

Iranian Foreign Minister Alaghi also said that Iran has never feared U.S. sanctions, and that past U.S. blockades or military actions have always failed. Trump’s new round of "economic action" is just another example of U.S. bullying. He believes that, aside from engaging in respectful dialogue with Iran and seeking solutions based on fairness and honor, the U.S. has no other options.

However, Iranian President Raisi said on the evening of the 22nd that Iran should also act rationally to get the country out of a state that is "neither war nor peace." He pointed out that Iran cannot rely on war forever, and that in a war or "neither war nor peace" state it is also difficult to attract investment.

Meanwhile, the U.S. maritime blockade against Iran continues. The U.S. Central Command stated that as of August 23, U.S. forces had directed 70 merchant vessels to change course, rendering 3 vessels unable to operate and inspecting 2 vessels. The destroyer "USS John Finn" is currently carrying out related missions in the Arabian Sea.

items.title: 史無前例！伊朗駭客成功癱瘓英國發電廠
items.title_en: Unprecedented! Iranian Hackers Successfully Disable UK Power Plant
paras: 伊朗在一場史無前例的網路攻擊中，迫使英國一座發電廠停運了整整四天，這是伊朗駭客首次成功癱瘓英國發電設施的案例。
英國官員以安全問題為由，拒絕透露受影響的是哪座發電廠。該發電廠規模相對較小，停運並未給英國整體電力供應或能源生產帶來影響。
英國政府向各家電力公司執行長通報了情況，並向企業發出通知，提供相關建議、指示以及下一步行動方案。
此次事件發生的時間與上月美國供水基礎設施遭受的一系列攻擊相吻合，後者影響了美國12個州，並引發白宮擔憂。
據英國《每日電訊報》22日（上周六）報導，此次針對英國發電廠的攻擊不太可能是為了影響平民，而是旨在證明：「與伊朗伊斯蘭革命衛隊有關的駭客有能力侵入英國系統。」
paras_en: Iran carried out an unprecedented cyber attack that forced a UK power plant to shut down for a full four days, marking the first time Iranian hackers have successfully crippled a UK power facility.

UK officials, citing security concerns, refused to disclose which plant was affected. The plant was relatively small, and its shutdown did not impact the overall UK electricity supply or energy production.
The UK government notified the CEOs of all power companies and issued notices to the firms, providing relevant advice, instructions, and a plan for next steps.
The incident occurred at the same time as a series of attacks on US water infrastructure last month, which affected 12 states and raised concerns at the White House.

According to the UK Daily Telegraph on the 22nd (last Saturday), the attack on the UK power plant was unlikely aimed at affecting civilians but was intended to demonstrate that "hackers linked to the Iranian Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps have the capability to infiltrate UK systems."

items.title: 貝森特撰文警告「經濟D-Day」黎明將襲伊朗！籲支持國「慎重考慮後果」
items.title_en: Bessent Warns of an "Economic D-Day" Dawn Attacking Iran, Urges Supporters to Carefully Consider Consequences
paras: 美國財政部長貝森特（Scott Bessent）週日（23日）發文警告，針對伊朗的「經濟諾曼第登陸日」（ECONOMIC D-DAY）即將到來，美國將發動前所未有的金融攻勢，並向持續與德黑蘭進行商業往來的國家發出警告，但並未透露具體措施。
貝森特在《金融時報》刊登的專欄文章中表示：「黎明時分，一場經濟諾曼第登陸日即將展開，這是有史以來針對對手所動員的最大規模金融攻勢。」
他表示：「全世界都應該明白，我們的目標是切斷支撐這個暴政政權的每一條經濟命脈，直到德黑蘭陷入孤立。」
該文章刊登於他預定舉行記者會的前一天。貝森特預定於週一（24日）下午2時（台灣時間25日凌晨2時）舉行記者會。
貝森特這篇文章的說法，也呼應美國總統川普上週的談話。川普當時同樣威脅將對伊朗發動「經濟D日」，並誓言對與德黑蘭進行商業往來的國家施加「巨大的經濟後果」。
與此同時，美國正試圖進一步加大經濟壓力，迫使德黑蘭重返談判桌。
貝森特在《金融時報》文章中寫道：「伊朗的支持者購買並運輸其石油。」他補充指出，這些國家「對海上燃料轉運及銀行遭非法利用視而不見，同時掩蓋自身涉入其中的程度」。
他寫道：「簡而言之，這些國家認為對該政權採取綏靖政策是更安全的做法。但它們最好仔細考慮持續維繫這個政權所帶來的後果。」
貝森特也警告，如果伊朗以軍事手段回應美國的經濟行動，川普將「迅速且果斷地作出回應」。
另根據《路透》報導，伊朗外交部長阿拉格齊（Abbas Araqchi）週日（23日）駁斥美國可能祭出的新一輪制裁，稱相關威脅反映美方已陷入「絕望」，並強調新的制裁措施無法迫使德黑蘭屈服。
阿拉格齊將相關情勢形容為「一再重複的劇本」，並在Telegram發布的影片中表示：「他們（美國領導人）從軍事行動……轉而提出同樣的老套計畫，這顯示他們已經絕望。」
他表示，美國若要尋求「建立在正義與尊嚴之上的解決方案」，就必須以尊重的態度與伊朗對話。
阿拉格齊說：「我們從未感到害怕。他們採取的所有行動，無論是封鎖或其他軍事措施，都已經失敗，而他們這次提出的新措施也同樣會失敗。」
paras_en: On Sunday (23rd), U.S. Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent posted a warning that the "Economic D-Day" against Iran is imminent, announcing an unprecedented financial onslaught and issuing a caution to countries that continue commercial dealings with Tehran, though he did not disclose specific measures.
In a column in the Financial Times, Bessent wrote: "At dawn, an economic Normandy landing day is about to unfold, the largest financial assault ever mobilized against an adversary."
He added: "The whole world should understand that our goal is to sever every economic lifeline that supports this tyrannical regime until Tehran is isolated."
The article appeared the day before his scheduled press conference. Bessent is set to hold the briefing on Monday (24th) at 2 p.m. Taiwan time, which is 2 a.m. on the 25th there.

Bessent’s remarks echo President Trump’s comments last week. Trump likewise threatened an "Economic D-Day" against Iran and vowed to impose "huge economic consequences" on nations that trade with Tehran.
Meanwhile, the U.S. is attempting to intensify economic pressure to force Tehran back to the negotiating table.

In the Financial Times piece, Bessent wrote: "Iran’s supporters buy and transport its oil." He added that these countries "turn a blind eye to maritime fuel transit and the illicit use of banks, while concealing their own involvement."
He wrote: "In short, these countries believe that a policy of appeasement toward the regime is safer. But they should carefully consider the consequences of sustaining this regime."
Bessent also warned that if Iran responds militarily to U.S. economic actions, Trump will "respond swiftly and decisively."

According to Reuters, on Sunday (23rd) Iranian Foreign Minister Abbas Araqchi dismissed the possibility of a new round of U.S. sanctions, saying the threats reflect the U.S. side’s despair and that new measures cannot force Tehran to capitulate.

Araqchi described the situation as a "repeating script" and in a video posted on Telegram said: "They (U.S. leaders) shift from military action… to the same old plan, showing they are already desperate."
He said that if the U.S. seeks a solution built on justice and dignity, it must engage Iran in dialogue with respect.
Araqchi added: "We have never felt afraid. All their actions, whether blockades or other military measures, have failed, and the new measures they propose this time will also fail."

items.title: 歐洲葡萄酒商夢碎 中國需求退潮 訂單量斷崖式減少
items.title_en: European Wine Companies' Dream Crumbles as Chinese Demand Slows, Orders Plummet
paras: 據香港英文媒體《南華早報》23日（周日）報導，曾被視為歐洲葡萄酒業下一個增長引擎的中國市場，正經歷一場持續而深刻的需求退潮。
最新貿易數據顯示，中國對歐盟瓶裝葡萄酒的進口量在2026年上半年較去年同期銳減16.6%，進口額下降7.9%至2.51億美元。
這一數字不僅延續了數年下行曲線，更代表新冠肺炎疫情後短暫反彈徹底消散，歐洲酒商的「中國夢」正被現實重新校準。
在巴黎從事中法葡萄酒貿易的Arsen Zhao表示，其法國本地業務依然穩健，但亞洲——尤其是中國買家的訂單量出現「斷崖式減少」。「中國客戶的降幅最為明顯，消費降級已成普遍現象。過去幾年積壓的大量高檔歐洲葡萄酒仍在渠道內待售，高庫存直接抑制了新的採購需求。」
他進一步指出，供需失衡已開始扭曲價格體系，「部分頂級法國名莊酒在中國的終端售價，甚至低於其在法國本土的零售價，這在以前幾乎不可想像。」
需求萎縮的背後，是多重結構性因素疊加。一方面，中國年輕消費群體的飲酒偏好正從「炫耀性消費」轉向「悅己化、場景化」，對高價進口酒追捧熱度降溫；另一方面，宏觀經濟放緩與房地產財富效應消退，進一步壓縮了商務宴請和禮品市場的購酒預算。
與此同時，中國國產葡萄酒崛起悄然改寫競爭格局——雲南香格里拉、寧夏賀蘭山東麓、山東蓬萊等產區的酒莊，憑藉持續提升的釀造工藝和國際獎項背書，已成功吸引一批原本只認「舊世界」標簽的消費者。
馬德里一位資深葡萄酒出口商坦言，中國雖非其最大市場，但曾長期保持穩定出貨。高峰年份對華年出口超過3,000瓶，主要供應上海、深圳等一線城市西式餐廳。然而，今年其預估對華銷量將驟降至不足900瓶。
面對這一變局，越來越多歐洲供應商開始調整重心，減少對華出貨量，並將目光投向加拿大、印度、東南亞及南美等新興市場。
paras_en: According to the Hong Kong English-language media South China Morning Post on Sunday the 23rd, the Chinese market, once seen as the next growth engine for European wine, is experiencing a sustained and profound decline in demand.
Latest trade data shows that imports of bottled wine from the EU into China fell 16.6% year‑on‑year in the first half of 2026, with import value down 7.9% to US$251 million.

This figure not only continues a multi‑year downward trend but also signals the complete disappearance of the brief post‑COVID rebound, forcing European wine merchants to recalibrate their "Chinese dream" in reality.

Arsen Zhao, who runs French‑Chinese wine trade in Paris, said his local French business remains solid, but orders from Asia—especially China—have "plunged dramatically." He added that the sharp decline among Chinese customers is most obvious, with a general shift to lower‑end consumption; the large backlog of high‑end European wines from recent years still sits in channels, and high inventory directly suppresses new purchasing demand.

He further pointed out that the supply‑demand imbalance has begun to distort price structures, with some top French estates selling in China at end‑user prices even lower than their retail prices in France—a scenario once almost unimaginable.

Behind the shrinking demand are multiple structural factors. On one hand, Chinese young consumers are shifting from "show‑off consumption" to "self‑enjoyment and scene‑based" preferences, cooling the enthusiasm for high‑priced imports; on the other hand, macroeconomic slowdown and the fading real‑estate wealth effect further squeeze budgets for business banquets and gift markets.

Meanwhile, the rise of domestic Chinese wine is quietly rewriting the competitive landscape—vineyards in Yunnan Shangri‑La, Ningxia Hulan Mountain foothills, and Shandong Penglai, among others, have attracted a cohort of consumers who previously only recognized "Old World" labels, thanks to continuously improving winemaking techniques and international awards.

A senior wine exporter in Madrid admitted that China is not their largest market, but it has long maintained stable shipments. In peak years, exports to China exceeded 3,000 bottles, mainly supplying Western‑style restaurants in first‑tier cities such as Shanghai and Shenzhen. However, this year they expect sales to China to drop sharply to less than 900 bottles.

Facing this shift, an increasing number of European suppliers are adjusting their focus, reducing shipments to China and turning their attention to emerging markets such as Canada, India, Southeast Asia, and South America.

items.title: 避險基金加碼做空美元   貝森特擴大長債回購引發信心危機
items.title_en: Hedge Funds Ramp Up Short Positions on the Dollar as Bentsen Expands Long‑Term Treasury Repurchase, Triggering Confidence Crisis
paras: 市場靜待美國財長貝森特公佈新財政計畫細節應對借貸成本居數十年高點之際，避險基金正大舉加碼美元空頭押注。
上周三(19日)，貝森特宣佈將10至30年期美債回購規模「至少翻倍」，美元應聲創下近三週最大單日跌幅紀錄，現貨市場湧現拋售潮，今(24)日在亞洲匯市早盤則變化不大。
巴克莱銀行G10貨幣交易聯席主管Torsten Schöneborn指出，避險基金在線性外匯交易上反應尤為劇烈，延續8月以來的美元賣壓。
投資人擔憂，美國財政部以激進手段壓長端利率，等於用行政力量扭曲定價，最終將侵蝕市場對美元的信心。
與此同時，選擇權市場也釋出悲觀信號：防範美元未來一個月下跌的溢價已攀升至2月以來最高。
花旗亞太區外匯選擇權主管 Akshay Saxena表示，自長債回購計畫公佈後，對沖美元下行風險的需求明顯擴散，貝森特的「殖利率管理」正把財政部推向聯準會(Fed)的角色，而代價可能是美元儲備貨幣的光環進一步褪色。
paras_en: The market is awaiting Treasury Secretary Janet Bentsen’s announcement of new fiscal plans to address borrowing costs at multi‑decade highs, while hedge funds are dramatically increasing short bets on the dollar.

On Wednesday (19th), Bentsen announced that the Treasury’s 10‑ to 30‑year Treasury repurchase program would be "at least doubled," prompting the dollar to record its largest single‑day decline in nearly three weeks; the spot market saw a wave of sell‑offs, and the Asian currency market remained largely unchanged on Thursday (24th).

Torsten Schöneborn, co‑head of G10 currency trading at Barclays, noted that hedge funds are reacting especially sharply in linear FX trading, continuing the dollar selling pressure that has persisted since August.
Investors worry that the Treasury’s aggressive tactics to suppress long‑term rates amount to using executive power to distort pricing, ultimately eroding confidence in the dollar.
At the same time, the options market is sending a bearish signal: the premium to hedge against a dollar decline over the next month has risen to its highest level since February.

Akshay Saxena, head of FX options for Citi Asia Pacific, said that since the long‑term repurchase plan was announced, demand to hedge against dollar downside has clearly expanded; Bentsen’s "yield‑management" is pushing the Treasury toward a Fed‑like role, and the cost may be further erosion of the dollar’s reserve‑currency halo.

美國財政部長貝森特稱可能再擴大回購美國公債規模及將與預算辦公室主任沃特共同啟動一項新財政整頓，但市場擔憂美國財政狀況惡化及制度的可信度，這些舉措未能阻止美國公債遭拋售，上週五壓抑美元；此外，日本7月核心消費者物價指數(CPI)較上年同期升1.8%符合預期及核心-核心CPI較去年同期漲幅擴大至1.9%，突顯企業將進口成本上漲轉嫁消費者，增添日本央行(BOJ)加息理據，並據標準普爾(S&P)全球初值調查，因新訂單增速達2018年1月以來最高，8月日本製造業與服務業採購經理人指數(PMI)分別升至55.1及52.3，推動綜合PMI創2月以來最高53.4，而且日本首相高市早苗認為通貨膨脹和債券收益率上升，反映日本經濟增長，激勵日圓上漲，美元兌日圓自159.13高點下跌。

據兩名政府消息人士稱，日本財務省考下一財政年預算申請中，假設償還債務成本利率為二十九年來最高3.8%，給緊張的財政狀況帶來壓力，但BOJ公布政策委員會將於明年7月21和22日舉行利率審議會議，讓鷹派委員田村直樹和高田創能夠參與會議表決，料對利率決策產生關鍵影響，打壓美元兌日圓至158.33低點。隨著S&P全球8月美國製造業PMI降至五個月低點53.2，但服務業PMI升至2024年12月以來最高56.8，推動綜合產出指數升至創2022年4月以來新高56.0，料美國整體經濟增長有望達第二季1.5%年化增速兩倍，限制美元下跌。預估今日美元兌日圓阻力於158.90-159.10，支撐於158.00-20。

據上週五S&P全球8月初值調查，澳洲服務業與綜合PMI分別降至52.9及52.5，製造業PMI則持平52.0，但美國財政部意外干預債券市場計畫僅提供不到一天喘息，市場日益擔憂美國債務和政策不確定性侵蝕美元購買力，令美元普遍走疲，澳幣有望創2020年以來最長周線連漲紀錄，紐元則創近十二周新高，帶動歐元兌美元觸及1.1711高點。
隨著S&P全球編制8月綜合PMI初值調查，歐元區升至去年11月以來新高52.1，但德國與法國分別跌至51.0及48.8，而且歐洲央行(ECB)調查7月歐元區消費者對未來十二個月與三年通貨膨脹率預期中值分別降至2.9%及2.7%，為連續三個月下調，打擊歐元兌美元至1.1668低點。預估今日歐元兌美元支撐於1.1650-70，阻力於1.1740-60。
◆GBP/USD

上週五調查顯示，英國8月GfK消費者信心指數升至兩年高點達負14，但英國通貨膨脹導致政府支出增加，抵消當月創紀錄的自行申報所得稅收入，7月意外錄得18億英鎊預算赤字，而且英國7月零售銷售如預期跌0.5%，拖累英鎊兌美元自1.3675高點下滑。隨後調查顯示S&P全球8月英國服務業PMI創六個月新高52.8及製造業PMI為51.5符合預期，但經濟學家的對英國央行(BOE)升息的預期與市場定價之間脫節，推低英鎊兌美元至1.3615低點。預估今日英鎊兌美元支撐於1.3620-40，阻力於1.3720-40。

items.title: 美國變了！加總理強硬掀桌  專家：卡尼藏有兩張王牌 墨國恐成美加關稅戰直接受害者
items.title_en: The U.S. Has Changed! Prime Minister Trudeau’s Hardline Move Shakes the Table: Experts Say Trudeau Holds Two Trump Cards, Mexico May Become the Direct Victim of a U.S.-Canada Tariff War
paras: 美東時間周六(22日)凌晨00:01，美國依據《1930年關稅法》第338條對約200億美元加拿大商品加徵50%關稅正式生效，涵蓋紅酒、啤酒、曲棍球棒、水泥、膠合板、牛奶、部分服裝等數百項特定產品。
數小時後，加拿大總理卡尼發表逾20分鐘全國電視講話，宣布暫停談判、召回代表團，並明示9月8日起對美啟動等額報復性關稅，範圍含乳製品、鋼鐵、家電、電子產品、紙漿造紙等。
卡尼說：「當你受到攻擊時，你就處於戰爭狀態——我們確實遭到了攻擊。美國已經變了，有時它的簽字是用鉛筆寫的。」
談判並非沒有接近過終點。8月18日川普暫緩三天徵稅，勒布朗與美國貿易代表格里爾在華盛頓連談三日，加國已釋出取消數字服務稅、松綁各省禁售美酒、戈迪·豪大橋部分通行費讓利等善意。 但21日下午情勢急轉：格里爾皺眉走進會議室，幾小時後談判崩潰。
卡尼歸咎於美方臨界一腳拋出三道越界條款：限制加國與第三國簽新貿易協議的能力；干涉法語、文化保護等主權事項；汽車產業「美國含量」原則極不公平，美國則反指加國後期新增中重型卡車關稅延展等訴求、翻燒餅式地反悔，格里爾稱華府給予加國「更優惠市場准入」，是加國拒簽導致破局。
廣東外語外貿大學加拿大研究中心研究員劉丹則指出，根本矛盾在美國，因出普要按「美國優先」重塑北美規則，加國象徵性讓步填不滿美方訴求。
美國既逼加國在關稅上退讓，又逼其在大國博弈中選邊，種子早在《USMCA》續簽僵局時已埋下。
單純看200億美元，未動能源、鉀肥、多數汽車零件，對兩國GDP直接衝擊有限。分析師預估，加國恐流失9萬崗位、GDP降0.3%—0.6%，美國則由進口商轉嫁物價、擾動中期選舉通膨敘事，但受傷的是魁北克乳業、安大略鋼鐵與家電、卑詩木材這些自由黨票倉企業，皇冠威士忌、鵝絨服、冰球裝備在美國零售端立刻變貴。
美國貿易官Ryan Majerus警告：「承壓的兩國都必須找脫身之計，但加國若也開徵，脫身會更難。」
加拿大商會主席Candace Laing直言，關稅戰對「整個北美競爭力是沉重打擊」。
真正的長尾成本在制度預期。《USMCA》原定2036年到期，2026年7月首次聯合審查後美方拒絕續簽16年，改採「逐年復審」，如今美加雙邊談崩、美墨雙邊續談，三邊框架實質退化為兩條雙邊軌道。
企業搭供應鏈週期經常超過10年，對此牛津經濟研究院預估，若USMCA體系瓦解疊加高關稅，10年恐令美國損失超1兆美元。此前，加美商業理事會預估，到2027年，美加分別有21.4萬與10.2萬職缺減少。
劉丹還指出，卡尼留了能源與關鍵礦產兩張牌，這正是川普對加重點訴求區，也是加國唯一能令華盛頓皺眉的槓桿。短期加國努力擴大亞洲歐洲替代不了72%對美出口依賴，但「去單一化」已寫入卡尼競選基因。
接下來走勢由兩個選舉鐘擺決定：美國期中選舉前若選民不在乎北美秩序破損，川普繼續「338條+鉛筆簽名」玩法；一旦通膨反噬選情，策略恐將調整。
在加國，則須考慮就業、反對黨攻勢與民意，因Abacus民調顯示74%民眾覺貿易爭端傷家計、僅18%支持讓步，請願驅逐美駐加大使簽近25萬，民調不允許卡尼回頭。
當338條這種百年冷門法條被喚醒，北美貿易的底層代碼就不再只是匯率與配額，而是「簽字用鉛筆還是用鋼印」的問題。
paras_en: At 12:01 a.m. Eastern Time on Saturday (the 22nd), the United States officially imposed a 50% tariff on about $20 billion worth of Canadian goods under Section 338 of the 1930 Tariff Act, covering hundreds of specific products including red wine, beer, hockey sticks, cement, plywood, milk, and certain apparel.

A few hours later, Canadian Prime Minister Justin Trudeau delivered a more than 20‑minute televised address to the nation, announcing a suspension of negotiations, the recall of the trade delegation, and a clear statement that from September 8th the U.S. would face equal retaliatory tariffs covering dairy, steel, household appliances, electronics, pulp and paper, and more.
Trudeau said, “When you are attacked, you are in a state of war—indeed we have been attacked. The United States has changed, and sometimes its signatures are written with a pencil.”

Negotiations had approached a conclusion. On August 18, Trump temporarily paused the tariffs for three days, and LeBron and U.S. Trade Representative Katherine Graham met in Washington for three days. Canada had offered to eliminate the digital services tax, loosen provincial bans on American wine, and reduce tolls on the Gordie Hawley Bridge, among other goodwill gestures. But on the afternoon of the 21st, the situation turned sharply: Graham frowned as she entered the meeting room, and a few hours later negotiations collapsed.

Trudeau blamed the U.S. for throwing three over‑the‑line provisions: limiting Canada’s ability to sign new trade agreements with third countries; interfering in sovereignty matters such as French language and cultural protection; and an unfair “U.S. content” rule in the automotive sector. The U.S. counter‑accused Canada of adding tariffs on medium‑heavy trucks later in the year and made a hasty reversal, while Graham claimed Washington offered Canada “more favorable market access,” which Canada rejected, leading to the breakdown.

Liu Dan, a researcher at Guangdong University of Foreign Studies’ Canadian Studies Center, pointed out that the fundamental conflict lies with the U.S., which insists on reshaping North American rules under a “U.S. first” mandate. Canada’s symbolic concessions failed to satisfy U.S. demands.
The U.S. forced Canada to concede on tariffs and to choose sides in a great‑power game, a seed that was already sown during the USMCA renewal stalemate.

Looking solely at the $20 billion, which excludes energy, potash, and most auto parts, the direct impact on both countries’ GDP is limited. Analysts estimate Canada could lose 90,000 jobs and see GDP fall by 0.3%–0.6%, while the U.S. would shift costs to importers, disrupt mid‑term election inflation narratives, and hurt Quebec dairy, Ontario steel and appliances, and British Columbia lumber—key Liberal‑vote‑bank businesses. Crown whisky, down‑feather coats, and hockey equipment would immediately become more expensive on the U.S. retail side.
U.S. trade official Ryan Majerus warned, “Both pressured countries must find a way out, but if Canada also imposes tariffs, it will be even harder to escape.”
Canadian Chamber of Commerce president Candace Laing bluntly said the tariff war is a heavy blow to “the entire North American competitiveness.”

The real long‑tail cost lies in institutional expectations. The USMCA was set to expire in 2036, but after the first joint review in July 2026, the U.S. rejected a 16‑year renewal and adopted a “year‑by‑year review” approach. Now, with U.S.–Canada talks collapsed, U.S.–Mexico and Canada–Mexico negotiations, the three‑party framework has effectively degraded into two bilateral tracks.

Companies’ supply‑chain cycles often exceed ten years. Oxford Economics estimates that if the USMCA system collapses and high tariffs are imposed, the U.S. could lose over $1 trillion in ten years. The U.S.–Canada Business Council previously estimated that by 2027, Canada and the U.S. would see 214,000 and 102,000 job losses, respectively.

Liu Dan also noted that Trudeau kept two cards—energy and critical minerals—which are exactly the areas Trump has focused on, and the only leverage Canada has to make Washington frown. In the short term, Canada’s efforts to expand Asian and European alternatives cannot replace its 72% dependence on U.S. exports, but “de‑single‑ling” has been written into Trudeau’s campaign DNA.

The next trajectory will be decided by two election clocks: if U.S. voters before the midterm elections do not care about a broken North American order, Trump will continue the “Section 338 + pencil‑signature” play; if inflation backlash affects the election, the strategy may shift.

In Canada, considerations include employment, opposition attacks, and public opinion. An Abacus poll shows 74% of people feel the trade dispute hurts household finances, while only 18% support concessions. Petitions have driven nearly 250,000 signatures for the U.S. ambassador in Canada, and the poll does not allow Trudeau to back down.

When a century‑old, rarely used provision like Section 338 is revived, the underlying code of North American trade is no longer just about exchange rates and quotas, but about whether signatures are made with a pencil or a steel‑stamp.

items.title: 日本有重演1997亞洲金融危機風險？野村：需將「貝森特看跌期權」效果減弱視為前車之鑑
items.title_en: Is Japan Facing a Repeat of the 1997 Asian Financial Crisis? Nomura: Weakened Effect of the “Bessent Put” Should Be Seen as a Warning
paras: 本週，全球金融市場罕見股、債、匯同步承壓的情況，市場質疑美國財政部穩定長債殖利率的政策效果。野村證券警告，日本若仿效美國壓低長債殖利率，壓力恐轉向日元，甚至增加資本外流、重蹈1997年亞洲金融危機風險。
野村證券宏觀策略師松澤中指出，美國財政部長貝森特（Scott Bessent）透過擴大美債回購壓低長天期殖利率的做法，所謂的「貝森特看跌期權」（Bessent put）可能正在失去作用。
美財政部的政策介入不僅未能持續穩住債市，反而進一步加大美元的下行壓力。
美國財政部週三宣布，將10年至30年期美債回購規模至少提高一倍，距離上一次公布回購計畫僅約兩週。
然而，市場對政策的正面反應不到一天便消退，長天期美債殖利率短暫回落後迅速反彈，整週大致維持在相近水準。
更值得關注的是，美國目前穩定長債市場的政策操作，可能為日本提供一個警示案例。
松澤中指出，若日本未來透過調整國債供給來壓低長期融資成本，市場壓力未必會消失，反而可能轉嫁至匯率市場，導致日元進一步走弱；若投資人信心同步惡化，甚至可能演變為資本外流，增加類似1997年亞洲金融危機的風險。

美國財政部干預債市　市場反而擔心美元承壓

分析指出，市場對貝森特政策的反應，在美元上甚至比美債更加明顯，使美元明顯走弱。
投資人擔心，如果財政部持續透過調整美債供需來穩定長天期殖利率，市場原本應透過貨幣政策收緊來處理的問題，可能被進一步延後，或使貨幣政策維持相對寬鬆的時間拉長。
貝森特此前曾表示，市場對通膨的擔憂與基本面並不一致，並認為目前的通膨壓力主要來自能源，而且是暫時性因素。
不過，聯準會本週公布的FOMC會議紀要顯示，官員對人工智慧（AI）可能帶來的通膨影響仍存在明顯分歧，目前尚未形成共識。
這也讓市場更加關注，美國政策制定者是否低估AI投資對經濟成長、通膨以及資金需求所產生的影響。

野村警告日本　壓低長債殖利率恐轉化為日元貶值

野村證券進一步提醒，日本可能需要把美國「貝森特看跌期權」效果減弱視為前車之鑑。
松澤中指出，如果日本也試圖透過控制國債供給等方式壓低長期融資成本，市場壓力可能不會消失，而是從債券市場轉移至匯率市場，最終反映為日元貶值。
本週日元仍處於弱勢，日本股市則在主要市場中跌幅最大，下跌3.3%，美國與歐洲股市分別下跌1.9%及1.1%。
債市方面，10年期美債殖利率上升1個基點，歐洲國債殖利率上升5個基點，但日本10年期國債殖利率反而下滑3個基點，呈現明顯背離。
野村認為，如果日本仿效美國，透過減少長天期國債發行等供需措施壓低殖利率，政策副作用可能更多反映在日元匯率。
由於日本央行持有的日本國債比例接近50%，對債市的影響力實際上高於美聯準會，但這也代表市場扭曲可能更容易轉移至匯率市場。
松澤中認為，日元本身已是弱勢貨幣，與美元這類主要儲備貨幣的情況不同。若日本政策出現偏差，日本可能面臨從資本流入國轉變為資本外流來源的風險。他並將當前環境類比於1990年代科技繁榮時期亞洲貨幣危機加劇的背景。
在此情況下，他認為日本至少需要明確表態放棄反通膨的大規模政策信貸，作為穩定市場預期的必要條件。

日本央行升息預期升溫　9月升息機率達8成

另一方面，市場對日本銀行貨幣政策正常化的預期也持續升溫。
目前市場定價顯示，日本央行9月升息的機率已升至約80%，同時反映未來3次升息、政策利率最終升至1.75%的預期；日本最終利率預期，即2年期遠期OIS，也從2.19%升至2.23%。
日本央行近期釋出的政策訊號偏向鷹派，市場甚至開始討論加快升息步調的可能性。
不過，野村證券認為，日本經濟目前仍具有一定韌性，日本央行副行長冰見野良三的談話可能進一步提高市場對9月升息的預期，但不代表央行一定會承諾更快的升息步調。
因此，在市場已高度反映升息預期的情況下，即使9月升息成真，也未必能成為新的市場利多催化劑。
除了貨幣政策之外，市場另一項關注焦點是科技企業債券與政府債券之間日益激烈的資金競爭。
部分大型科技公司的信用違約交換（CDS）利差已升至歷史高位，反映市場開始擔心AI巨額資本支出對企業融資能力造成壓力。
AI投資所需的龐大資金需求正在向信用市場傳導，並與政府發債形成資金競爭。
雖然近期美國財報季進一步驗證AI投資對企業獲利及資本支出的支撐，但如果科技企業債市場持續承壓，企業融資成本與市場風險偏好的變化，也可能反過來影響股市。
因此，科技企業債市場能否穩定，可能成為觀察下週股市能否維持韌性的重要外部指標。
此外，投資人也將關注Jackson Hole全球央行年會，尤其是聯準會主席華許（Kevin Warsh）對資產負債表政策、即量化緊縮（QT）的看法。
如果華許釋放持續縮減資產負債表、避免向金融市場提供過多流動性的訊號，金融市場流動性可能進一步收緊，進而對股市形成壓力。
paras_en: This week, global financial markets experienced the rare simultaneous pressure on equities, bonds, and currencies, prompting doubts about the effectiveness of the U.S. Treasury’s policy to stabilise long‑term bond yields. Nomura Securities warned that if Japan follows the U.S. in trying to push down long‑term yields, the pressure could shift to the yen and even trigger capital outflows, reviving the risk of a repeat of the 1997 Asian financial crisis.

Nomura macro‑strategist Matsuzawa Naka noted that U.S. Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent’s strategy of expanding Treasury repurchase operations to lower long‑term yields – the so‑called “Bessent put” – may be losing its potency.
The Treasury’s intervention has not only failed to keep the bond market stable, it has further increased downward pressure on the dollar.
On Wednesday, the Treasury announced it would at least double the size of its 10‑ to 30‑year Treasury repurchase programme, just about two weeks after the previous repurchase plan was disclosed.
However, the market’s positive reaction to the policy faded in less than a day; long‑term U.S. yields briefly fell before quickly rebounding, staying roughly flat for the rest of the week.
More importantly, the policy actions the United States is using to stabilise the long‑bond market could serve as a cautionary example for Japan.

Matsuzawa warned that if Japan later tries to lower long‑term financing costs by adjusting the supply of government bonds, market pressure may not disappear but could shift to the foreign‑exchange market, further weakening the yen; a simultaneous loss of investor confidence could even turn into capital outflows, raising the risk of a crisis similar to that of 1997 in Asia.

U.S. Treasury intervention in the bond market has instead raised concerns that the dollar is under pressure. Analysis shows that the market’s reaction to the Bessent policy is even more pronounced on the dollar than on Treasuries, causing the dollar to weaken noticeably.

Investors fear that if the Treasury continues to stabilise long‑term yields by tweaking U.S. bond supply and demand, problems that should be addressed by tighter monetary policy may be postponed, or monetary policy may remain relatively accommodative for a longer period.
Bessent previously said that market concerns about inflation are not aligned with fundamentals and that current inflation pressures stem mainly from energy costs and are temporary.
However, this week’s FOMC minutes showed that officials remain sharply divided on the inflationary impact of artificial intelligence (AI), and no consensus has been reached yet.
This has heightened market focus on whether U.S. policymakers are underestimating the effect of AI‑driven investment on economic growth, inflation and funding needs.
Nomura warned Japan that it may need to treat the weakening of the U.S. “Bessent put” as a precedent.

Matsuzawa said that if Japan also tries to lower long‑term financing costs by controlling government‑bond supply, market pressure is unlikely to vanish and could move from the bond market to the FX market, ultimately manifesting as yen depreciation.
The yen remained weak this week, and Japan’s equity market posted the biggest decline among major markets, down 3.3%, while U.S. and European stocks fell 1.9% and 1.1% respectively.

In the bond market, the 10‑year U.S. Treasury yield rose 1 basis point and European sovereign yields rose 5 basis points, whereas Japan’s 10‑year government‑bond yield fell 3 basis points, showing a clear divergence.
Nomura believes that if Japan mirrors the U.S. by reducing long‑term government‑bond issuance to push yields down, the policy’s side effects could show up more strongly in the yen’s exchange rate.

Because the Bank of Japan holds almost 50% of Japanese government bonds, its influence on the bond market is actually greater than that of the Fed, but this also means market distortions may more easily spill over into the FX market.

Matsuzawa noted that the yen is already a weak currency, unlike the dollar, which is a primary reserve asset. If Japanese policy deviates, Japan could shift from a net capital‑inflow country to a net capital‑outflow source. He likened the current environment to the backdrop of the Asian currency crises that intensified during the 1990s tech boom.
In this context, he says Japan at least needs to clearly state that it will abandon large‑scale anti‑inflation credit policies as a necessary condition for stabilising market expectations.
Expectations for a Bank of Japan rate hike are heating up, with the probability of a September hike now around 80%.

Current market pricing shows the probability of a September BOJ hike has risen to about 80%, also reflecting expectations of three more hikes and a final policy rate of 1.75%; the two‑year forward OIS rate has moved up from 2.19% to 2.23%.
Recent BOJ signals have tilted hawkish, and the market is even debating the possibility of accelerating the pace of hikes.

Nevertheless, Nomura argues that Japan’s economy still has some resilience; remarks by BOJ Deputy Governor Himemi Yoro‑san could further boost September‑hike expectations, but they do not guarantee the central bank will commit to a faster tightening path.
Thus, even if a September hike materialises, it may not become a fresh market catalyst given that the hike expectation is already largely priced in.
Beyond monetary policy, another market focus is the growing competition for funding between tech‑company bonds and sovereign bonds.
Credit‑default‑swap spreads on some large tech firms have surged to historic highs, reflecting worries that massive AI‑related capital spending could strain corporate financing capacity.
The huge funding needs of AI investment are flowing into credit markets and competing with government‑bond issuance for capital.

Although the latest U.S. earnings season has further validated that AI spending can support corporate profits and capex, persistent pressure on the tech‑bond market could alter corporate financing costs and risk appetite, which in turn may affect equity markets.
Therefore, the stability of the tech‑bond market could become an important external gauge of whether next week’s equity markets can maintain resilience.
Investors will also watch the Jackson Hole global central‑bank meeting, especially Fed Chair Kevin Warsh’s views on balance‑sheet policy and quantitative tightening (QT).
If Warsh signals a continued reduction of the balance sheet and a reluctance to flood markets with excess liquidity, financial‑market liquidity could tighten further, adding pressure to equities.

items.title_en: NY Forex: Dollar Falls to 3-Month Low, Weekly Decline Expands
paras: 美元周五(21日)走向7月底以來最差單周表現，受到根深蒂固的財政疑慮打擊。美國財政部意外出手干預，以遏制長天期公債的拋售潮，也引發市場對此類措施可能令美元承壓的擔憂。
紐約尾盤，追蹤美元兌六種主要貨幣的美元指數(DXY)下跌0.1%，報98.80，徘徊在3個月低點附近。本周下跌約0.9%。
外匯市場參與者本周一直關注固定收益市場。在周三之前，美國長天期公債尤其陷入拋售潮，自聯準會(Fed)7月利率決策後便大致持續走弱，原因包括油價上漲引發的通膨疑慮，以及大型企業為資助AI基礎設施支出而大量發行債務所引發的擔憂。30年期公債殖利率周二升至19年高點5.337%，10年期公債殖利率則創下52周新高4.748%。
短天期公債表現則好得多，近期經濟數據降低了市場對聯準會即將升息的預期。
隨後，美國財政部周三表示，將把長天期政府債務的回購規模從20億美元提高至至少40億美元。這項意外干預帶動長天期公債上漲，推動殖利率下滑。然而，這波漲勢大部分在周四和周五回吐，顯示交易員認為此舉只是一項短期解決方案。美國政府債務突破40兆美元的消息引發財政疑慮，也令市場氣氛蒙上陰影。
30年期公債殖利率最新上升3.9個基點至5.276%，10年期公債殖利率則上升4個基點至4.738%。
美國財政部長貝森特(Scott Bessent)周四試圖進一步提供支撐，他向CNBC表示，計畫中的回購規模可能高於已宣布的40億美元，並強調政府擁有「龐大工具箱」可以壓低殖利率。
殖利率上升往往會產生類似升息的效果，因為這會推高消費者與企業的借貸成本，而這通常也會推升美元。但美國政府不斷膨脹的債務已引發日益增加的財政疑慮，在此環境下，投資人會尋求將資金從法定貨幣轉向黃金或加密貨幣等硬資產，這種策略被稱為「貨幣貶值交易」。
布魯金斯學會經濟研究員Robin Brooks周四表示，「美國財政部昨天意外宣布增加長天期公債回購，釋放出兩個明確訊號。第一，近期長期殖利率升至20多年來最高水準，已觸及美國一個重要的痛點門檻。這類措施的問題在於，你等於亮出了自己的底牌，而現在事情已經發生了。」
「第二，也是遠為重要的訊號是，政府完全沒有意願面對根本問題，也就是財政政策已經失控，迫切需要控制赤字。相反的，昨天的宣布是一種金融工程，只是在掩蓋美國公債市場日益加劇的壓力。」Brooks補充，「當財政政策失控時，政府顯然可以採取許多措施來壓低殖利率，但這只會對貨幣造成貶值壓力，因為市場無法獲得其所要求的風險溢價。」
市場將焦點轉向下周的傑克森霍爾(Jackson Hole)經濟政策研討會，以尋找更多利率政策線索。
歐元與英鎊受益 日元終止干預後跌勢
歐洲主要貨幣受惠於美元本周走弱，升至數個月高點，並實現強勁的單周漲幅。
歐元兌美元報1.1679美元，徘徊在5月14日以來最高水準附近，本周已上漲1%。
英鎊兌美元報1.3646美元，為2月13日以來最高，本周上漲約0.8%。
英國政府本周稍早公布的數據顯示，7月整體年度消費者通膨較6月加速。
日元有望終止兌美元跌勢，此前美國與日本當局7月底進行歷史性聯合干預。美元兌日元本周下跌0.2%。
日元周五受到數據支撐，日本7月核心消費者通膨加速至1.8%，同時民間部門採購經理人指數數據強勁，進一步強化市場對日本銀行(BoJ)9月升息的預期。
